pages.rawText:
59 
 
Forage for Magical Herbs 
Ranger Utility 2 
You search the area for rare herbs you can utilize for rituals
. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Ritual, Wilderness, Martial Practice, 
Creation 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Requirement : You are in the wilderness above or below 
ground. 
Cast Time : 1 hour. 
Effect: Roll a Nature or Dungeoneering check to forage. The 
check is modified by the environment as with normal 
foraging rolls. If you succeed, instead of finding food, you find 
2x your skil check's worth of gold in Rare Herbs that can be 
used as components for Na ture rituals started by you or an 
ally until your next extended rest or in the next 24 hours 
(whichever is sooner). You may convert up to half of what 
you find into alchemical reagents, mystic salves, or sanctified 
incense (for Arcana, Heal, or Religion ri tuals). 
 At level 11, it increases to 10x your check's result. 
 At level 20, it increases to 20x your check's result. 
 
Galloping Jump 
Ranger Utility 2 
You and your mount dramatically jump over gaps and pits.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Beast, Exploration 
Free Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a horse beast companion 
Effect: You gain a +5 bonus to running jump checks while 
mounted on your beast companion during this turn. You can 
move 1 additional square after landing from a running jump, 
as long as it is in the same direction of the jump. 
 
 
Harvesting Useful 
Monster Parts 
Ranger Utility 2 
You carve up a monster to find in order to appropriate claws, teeth
fangs, scales, sinew, and more to other uses.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Martial Practice, 
Creation 
Minor Action 
Melee Weapon 
Target: One dead non -humanoid corpse. 
Cast Time: 10 minutes 
Effect: You create a single non -living, non-magical object from 
the target corpse. The corpse is destroyed as a result. The 
object is a single weapon, a set of 10 ammunition, or item 
from "Adventuring Gear" page 222 of the Player's Handbook 
that can be reasonably made from the creature's corpse 
(with the DM having the final word on whether such a 
chosen item is reasonable). Without proper preservation, the 
object lasts only until the end of your next extended rest. It 
can be integrated into the crafting of a more p ermanent, but 
still non-magical, item by someone with crafting abilities, but 
it costs as much as the item you want to make with a 20% 
discount. 
  
At the DM's discrention, you can also create some 
other non-magical object no longer than one a Medium 
creature can carry. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Intimidating Beast 
Companion 
Ranger Utility 2 
Your beast companion makes threatening growling noises or scary
motions, causing your opposition to hesitate to call your bluff.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Beast, Social 
Immediate Reaction 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a beast companion. 
Trigger: You make an Intimidate check to a creature or 
creatures that can see or hear your beast companion. 
Effect: You may make a second Intimidate roll with a +2 
bonus. You must use the second result. 
 
 
Silent Lizard 
Ranger Utility 2 
You can approach right next to someone without them realizing, a
you hardly make a sound. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Beast, Exploration 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a lizard beast companion. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, gain a +2 power bonus 
to your next Stealth check to stay quiet. This bonus is 
increased to a +4 bonus if you are at least mostly 
underwater, or have partial or total concealment. 
 
 
Springing Intimidation 
Ranger Utility 2 
You match your beast companion's aggressive energy. Your 
temperature rises, you look like you'll charge. Everyone begins to e
the nearest exit, move slow, and not make any sudden movements
scared of what you'll do next.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Martial, Beast, Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a boar or serpent beast 
companion.. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus to 
Intimidation checks you make. Within the next 5 minutes, if 
initiative is rolled because a combat encounter begins with 
enemies you see when the power is used and who are aware 
of you, you gain a +4 b onus to your initiative check, but you 
must make an attack on your first turn if able. 
 
 
Two-Bladed Weapons 
Demonstration 
Ranger Utility 2 
You spin and throw your swords in an incredible display
 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Martial, Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Requirement : You must be wielding at least two melee 
weapons. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you get a +4 bonus to 
skill or ability checks to distract, impress, or perform with 
any weapons you are wielding.

foraging rolls. If you succeed, instead of finding food, you find
2x your skil check's worth of gold in Rare Herbs that can be
used as components for Na ture rituals started by you or an
ally until your next extended rest or in the next 24 hours
(whichever is sooner). You may convert up to half of what
you find into alchemical reagents, mystic salves, or sanctified
incense (for Arcana, Heal, or Religion ri tuals).
At level 11, it increases to 10x your check's result.
At level 20, it increases to 20x your check's result.

Ranger Utility 2
You and your mount dramatically jump over gaps and pits.
Encounter + Non-Combat, Beast, Exploration
Free Action
Personal
Prerequisite: You must have a horse beast companion
Effect: You gain a +5 bonus to running jump checks while
mounted on your beast companion during this turn. You can
move 1 additional square after landing from a running jump,
as long as it is in the same direction of the jump.
Harvesting Useful
Ranger Utility 2
Monster Parts
You carve up a monster to find in order to appropriate claws, teeth
fangs, scales, sinew, and more to other uses.
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Martial Practice,
Creation
Minor Action
Melee Weapon
Target: One dead non -humanoid corpse.
Cast Time: 10 minutes
Effect: You create a single non -living, non-magical object from
the target corpse. The corpse is destroyed as a result. The
object is a single weapon, a set of 10 ammunition, or item
from "Adventuring Gear" page 222 of the Player's Handbook
that can be reasonably made from the creature's corpse
(with the DM having the final word on whether such a
chosen item is reasonable). Without proper preservation, the
object lasts only until the end of your next extended rest. It
can be integrated into the crafting of a more p ermanent, but
still non-magical, item by someone with crafting abilities, but
it costs as much as the item you want to make with a 20%
discount.

other non-magical object no longer than one a Medium

Ranger Utility 2
Companion

creatures that can see or hear your beast companion.

Ranger Utility 2

you hardly make a sound.

Minor Action
Personal

to your next Stealth check to stay quiet. This bonus is
increased to a +4 bonus if you are at least mostly
underwater, or have partial or total concealment.
Springing Intimidation
Ranger Utility 2

temperature rises, you look like you'll charge. Everyone begins to e
the nearest exit, move slow, and not make any sudden movements
scared of what you'll do next.
Encounter + Non-Combat, Martial, Beast, Social
Minor Action
Personal
Prerequisite: You must have a boar or serpent beast
companion..

initiative is rolled because a combat encounter begins with
enemies you see when the power is used and who are aware
of you, you gain a +4 b onus to your initiative check, but you
must make an attack on your first turn if able.

Ranger Utility 2
Demonstration
You spin and throw your swords in an incredible display
At-Will + Non-Combat, Martial, Social
Minor Action
Personal
Requirement : You must be wielding at least two melee
weapons.
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you get a +4 bonus to
skill or ability checks to distract, impress, or perform with
any weapons you are wielding.

Ursine Mini -Hibernation 
Ranger Utility 2 
You have an amazing sleep after eating way too much food.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Beast, Rest 
Standard Action 
Melee Weapon 
Prerequisite : You must have a bear beast companion . 
Requirement : You are taking an extended rest, and have 
double the food you normally need each day between the 
last day and this one. 
Effect: Double the duration of this extended rest. At the end, 
choose either Strength or Constitution. You gain a +2 bonus 
to ability and skill checks that use the chosen ability score 
until your next extended rest. You do not regain this power 
during that next ex tended rest. 
 
 
Eye From the Skies 
Ranger Utility 2 
With a bird's eye view, you can always make the best attack.
 
Encounter + Combat, Martial, Beast 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a raptor or simian beast 
companion. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus to 
your next attack rolls against a target at least 2 squares 
below you. If it was a melee attack, you also deal +2 damage.  
Also, until the end of your next turn, ranged and area 
attackas against you from at least 2 squares below you get a -
2 penalty. 
 
 
Large Equestrian Target 
Ranger Utility 2 
Your horse is a large target enemies find hard to avoid, but woe to
those who hit them. 
Encounter + Combat, Martial, Beast 
Immediate Interrupt 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a large beast companion with the 
mount keyword. 
Trigger :  You are hit by a ranged or melee attack while 
mounted on your beast companion. 
Effect: Reduce the damage dealt  by the triggering attack by 
your Wisdom modifier + 1 (minimum of 1). Then, half of the 
damage (rounded down) is dealt to you and half (rouned up) 
is dealt to your beast companion. Until the end of your next 
turn, your next martial attack deals extra damage equal to 
the amount dealt to your beast companion. 
 
 
Stalking Attack 
Ranger Utility 2 
You have learned from the patient spider or careful crocodile how 
attack your enemy when they are weakest.
 
Encounter + Combat, Martial, Beast 
Free Action 
Close Burst 20 
Prerequisite: You must have a spider or lizard beast 
companion. 
Target  One creature within line -of-sight of you or your beast 
companion that is slowed, grabbed, restrained, or in difficult 
terrain and affected by that difficult terrain. 
Effect: Until the end of this turn, the target grants you combat 
advantage. Also, if you hit them with an attack this turn, they 
take a -2 penalty to any saving throws or escape rolls they 
make until the end of their next turn.

Exploits/Evocations 
 
Favored Foe's Language 
Ranger Utility 6 
Following and observing your foes have given you increased 
knowledge in understanding how they communicate.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Martial, Gathering Information, 
Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You have the Favored Foe power (Ranger 2). 
Target:  One creature that is of the type of your favored foe; or 
a writing or drawing made from a creature that is of the type 
of your favored foe. 
Effect: Make a medium DC monster knowledge check based 
on the level of the target. If you succeed, you can understand 
and speak a language that the target knows until the end of 
the encounter and gain a +2 bonus to your next Diplomacy, 
Intimidation, Insight, or Na ture check against them. If you 
targeted a piece of writing or drawing, you can understand 
that, although you cannot write the language yourself from 
this power. If they don't speak a language, you still gain a +2 
bonus to your next Insight, Nature, and Ch arisma checks to 
understand and communicate with them in other ways 
(hands, body language, facial expressions, etc.) although the 
communication that can be given this way is often a lot 
rougher and more primitive. 
  
If you fail the monster knowledge check, you gain a 
rough understanding of the language of the target, enough to 
get a simple idea of what they are saying or trying to 
communicate (they are angry, they are happy, etc.)  unless 
they are trying to hide thei r intent; or you gain a single 
concept from a piece of writing (it looks like a warning, or it 
sounds welcoming, etc.) but you cannot speak or write their 
language. 
 
 
Favored Terrain's Deft 
Exploration 
Ranger Utility 6 
You can move through your favored terrain with ease and when 
guiding your party through it, travel becomes a breeze.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Travel, Wilderness 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You have the Favored Terrain power (Ranger 2). 
Target:  You and each ally in the party within sight and speech 
range. 
Effect: Until the end of your next extended rest, predominantly 
difficult terrain means your overland exploration speed is 
multiplied by 0.75x (instead of 0.5x). Also, your party is not 
slowed by widespread difficult terrain at all during overland 
exploration.  
  
Finally, you and your allies also gain a +2 bonus to 
initiative for the first combat encounter that occurs for the 
duration of this power when doing overland exploration in 
your favored terrain. 
 
 
 
Foraging for Healing 
Herbs 
Ranger Utility 6 
You search for herbs or fungi native to the area with medicinal 
properties. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Martial Practice, Wilderness, 
Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Csat Time :  1 hour 
Effect: Roll a Nature or Dungeoneering check to forage (based 
on your current environment). The check is modified by the 
environment, like normal foraging rolls. If you succeed, 
instead of finding food, you may choose a single result from 
the table below as long a s you reached that DC or higher. If 
you find herbs, they are a consumable item that only lasts 
until your next extended rest. 
 
DC 
Possible Forage Result

You find nothing.

worth of food or water for 
the day (or a source of 
water).

expended to gain 
temporary hit points equal 
to the user's healing surge 
value during a short or 
extended rest. 
20 or higher 
You find herbs that can be 
expended to regain a 
Ranger healing power the 
user has. It is a minor 
action to consume these.

Ranger Utility 10 
You clear the path ahead to make way for your companions behin
you. 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Exploration, Wilderness, Travel 
Standard Action 
Melee Weapon 
Requirement: You must be wielding at least two melee 
weapons. 
Target: One square of difficult terrain because of plants, wood, 
or fungus. 
Effect: You clear the difficult terrain in the target square. It is 
not considered difficult terrain anymore. 
Travel: While embarking on overland exploration or travel,

path that allows you or people who come after you through 
that same path ignore difficult terrain on their travel speed. 
 
Fetch! 
Ranger Utility 10 
Your beast companion is an expert at the game of fetch.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Beast 
Free Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You have a beast companion. 
Trigger  A creature catches or throws a weapon or other 
object. Either the thrower, target of the throw, or a square 
within line -of-effect of the throw must be within the speed 
distance of your beast companion. 
Effect: Your beast companion shifts to somewhere between 
the triggering thrower's line of effect to the catcher, or 
adjacent to the thrower or target square of the thrower. The 
beast companion catches the item and holds it if possible, 
otherwise they drop it in th eir square.  
  
They can then shift up to their speed again. If they 
end this action adjacent to you and are holding the item, you 
may take the object from them as a free action. 
 
 
Speedy Gallop 
Ranger Utility 10 
You drive your mount to extreme speeds over hill and far away.
 
Daily +  Non-Combat, Martial, Beast, Travel 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be mounted. 
Effect: The overland speed of your mount is increased by 3 
times. This power lasts for 10 hours or until you roll initiative 
for a combat encounter. You can't take actions other than 
free or move actions during this time, and you can't move 
silently. 
 
 
Common Mount Speeds with “Speedy 
Gallop” 
This is about 120 miles per day for your average war 
horse, 150 miles per day for your average riding horse, 
this is about 75 miles per day for your average cart or 
wagon.

Ranger Utility 10 
You begin to carve up the monster, taking the sharpest fangs, the 
hardest scales, or the most pliable sinew to help you with your 
journey. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Martial Practice, 
Creation 
Standard Action 
Melee Weapon 
Cast Time: 10 minutes. 
Target:  One dead non -humanoid and non -animate creature 
corpse. 
Effect: You create a single object from the target corpse. The 
corpse is destroyed as a result. The object is a single weapon, 
a set of 10 ammunition, armor, shield, a 
consumable/combustible item, or other equipment that can 
be reasonably made from the creature's corpse (the DM has 
the final word on this). It can be magical, but generally it's 
just an enhanced version of a mundane item with an 
enhancement bonus depending on the level the target was 
when alive, rather than containing a specific magical 
enchantment. 
  
Without proper preservation, the object lasts only 
until the end of your next extended rest. It can be made into 
a permanent item by someone with crafting abilities. Doing 
so costs as much as the item you are trying to make with a 
10% discount. It can't b e disenchanted until it's been made 
into a permanent item. 
  
You can also integrate it into the crafting of another 
magic item. Doing so either gives the crafter a 10% discount 
on that magic item, or at the DM's discretion they may 
choose to allow the crafted item to gain a new property 
based on the monster it was h arvested from instead (or in 
addition to the discount). This is usually only the case for 
particularly interesting parts craft from particularly rare or 
interesting monsters.

thrown weapon. 
Target  One creature. 
Attack: Dexterity vs AC. If you are not in combat, gain a +5 
bonus. 
Hit: Deal no damage, but the next Intimidation check made by 
you or an ally against the target gets a +5 bonus until the end 
of your next turn. If you hit the enemy's AC exactly or made a 
critical hit, the bonus increases to a +10 insead. 
 
Miss: Deal 1[W] damage. If this unexpectedly initiates combat, 
you and all non -Rogue allies get a -4 penalty to your initiative 
roll, or the combat begins with a surprise round that everyone 
but you is in. The DM may choose. 
Automatic Miss: If you roll a natural 1 on the attack roll or 
another form of an automatic miss , deal 3[W] damage instead. 
If this initiates combat, all allies of the target get a +2 bonus to 
their initiative and attack rolls the first round, in addition to 
the effects of a miss from this power. 
 
Speak With Other Beast s 
Ranger Utility 10 
Your beast companion can talk with other animals. It doesn't 
necessarily mean you can understand them or the animal they're 
talking to, but the beast companion may still take the initiative to 
useful information, lead you somewhere useful, or get help 
from the 
other animals during thsi time, depending on how smart they are, 
course. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Primal, Beast, Social, Wilderness
 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You have a beast companion. . 
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, your beast companion 
can speak to animal life (including beasts and magical 
beasts). Animals can communicate what they have seen, 
heard, or otherwise sensed within the last hour, and a hostile 
animal may even try to mislead your beast companion. Your 
beast companion gets a +2 bonus to Nature, Diplomacy, and 
Intimidation checks with other animals during this time. This 
bonus increases to a +5 bonus if they are speaking to 
someone of the same species or very similar (for exampl e, an 
alligator companion talking to a crocodile, a tiger companion 
talking to a lion, or an eagle companion talking to a hawk or 
falcon). 
 
 
Stealthy Wilderness Scout 
Ranger Utility 10 
You stealthily observe from within the leaves of a tree, or a pit belo
the snow. 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Martial, Exploration 
Free Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of this turn, you get a +2 bonus to 
Athletics checks to climb, and you get a +4 bonus to Stealth 
checks against other creatures while at least 2 squares above 
or below them. If at least 4 squares above or below them 
and you are at least partially obscured, the bonus increases 
to a +8.

Animal Pickpocket 
Ranger Utility 16 
You and your beast companion are partners in crime, able to pilife
from unaware enemies. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Martial, Beast 
Free Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite : You must have a medium or smaller beast 
companion. 
Requirement  You and your target must not be in combat; and 
the target is not aware of your beast companion. 
Effect: Your beast companion can move up to its speed +4, or 
move at half speed while hidden and make a Stealth check 
to stay hidden. Then, the beast companion attempts a 
Thievery check to pick a target's pocket or take an object the 
target is holding. They either use their Thievery skill with a 
+2 bonus or your Thievery skill, whichever is higher. 
  
Afterwards, they may attempt to move half their 
speed and hide with a Stealth check, or they can move up to 
their speed +4 again. 
  
If you are interacting with the target, you may make 
an Easy DC Bluff check (based on the target's level) with a +2 
bonus. If you succeed, the Thievery and Stealth checks get an 
additional +3 bonus. 
 
 
 
Player Notes: Animal Pickpocket
 
See normal rules on Thievery to Pick Pocket to see the 
required DC’s and consquences for pickpocketing.

My Ranger Needs Me 
Ranger Utility 1 6 
Your beast companion will escape any enclosure to reach you in 
time. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Beast, Destruction 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You have a medium or larger beast companion.. 
Effect: Your beast companion knows you need help, no matter 
their location, and they are compelled to try to travel to your 
location. For the next 5 minutes or until they reach your 
location, your beast companion gains a +5 bonus to Athletics 
checks to jump, climb , or run. They also gain a +5 bonus to 
Strength checks to break an object they are kept in (like a 
stable stall, a pen, a cage, etc) and they deal double damage 
to wall or door-like objects blocking the path beetween your 
animal companion and you. Their ba se movement speed is 
doubled. Add a +5 bonus to all their defenses until they 
reach you. 
  
 
They may also make a DC 20 Endurance 
check in order to extend these bonuses an extra hour, 
although they still end once the beast companion reaches 
you. 
 
 
Predator’s Skillful Pursuit 
Ranger Utility 16 
When you have a target in mind, you don't even have to actively 
track them to keep aware of all signs of their passing.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: Trained in Athletics and/or Acrobatics. 
Effect: Gain a +5 bonus to Athletics and/or Acrobatics skill 
checks, whichever you're trained in, during skill checks or 
skill challenges related to chases, hunting, or tracking as long 
as you are the pursuer. This effect lasts for the next 5 
minutes or until the end of the encounter. 
 
 
Still Target 
Ranger Utility 16 
While there's always some challenge hitting a moving target, whe
it comes to a still target, you hit the bullseye every, single time.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Martial,, W eapon 
Standard Action 
Ranged Weapon 
Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or crossbow. 
Target: One object that isn't on someone, held by someone, or 
moving. 
Attack: Dexterity + 10 vs AC. This attack cannot automatically 
miss and your weapon ranges are doubled. It also ignores 
cover, superior cover, and concealment. 
Hit: You may choose to interact with the object instead of 
damaging it. 
Effect: You may also gain a +10 bonus to your next 
performance-related skill and ability checks when exhibiting 
marksmanship against a non -moving target. 
 
 
Subconscious Tracking 
Ranger Utility 16 
When you have a target in mind, you don't even have to actively 
track them to keep aware of all signs of their passing.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial , Travel, Gathering 
Information 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of your next extended rest or combat 
encounter, your passive Perception gets a +5 bonus for the 
purpose of knowing if you pass a sign of someone or 
something you are tracking.  
  
During this time, if you are tracking a group and 
succeed a Medium DC active check (based on the creature 
with the lowest level of the group), you also know how many 
are in the area, their sizes, and how long ago they they 
passed the immediate area. 
  
During this time if you roll initiative to fight a target 
you've been tracking, you get a +2 bonus to your initiative. 
Favored Foe: If you have the Favored Foe power (Ranger 2), 
the Passive Perception bonus increases to a +10 bonus and 
the initiative bonus increases to a +5 bonus when related to 
your favored foe. 
 
 
Wilderness Expert 
Ranger Utility 16 
When you have a target in mind, you don't even have to actively 
track them to keep aware of all signs of their passing.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial , Travel, Wilderness 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement : You must be exploring or traveling in the 
wilderness, outside of an urban settlement. 
Effect: Choose one bonus from the list below. The bonuses last 
until your next short or extended rest, until initiative is rolled 
for combat, or you arrive in a town, village, or other urban 
settlement of some sort. If combat is only one round or 
completed with th e Quick and Dirty Fighting rules, it does 
not interrupt this effect. 
+ 
Gain a +5 bonus to your next Nature or 
Dungeoneering check to not become lost or to 
navigate a route, as long as you have been to this 
place before, planned a route previously through a 
map or directions, or have a map now. 
+ 
You can navigate stealthily while traveling at a 
normal pace. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to 
Stealth checks while traveling through the wild or 
over long distances. 
+ 
You can maintain alertness while doing another 
activity when doing overland travel/exploration. 
You can also scout and do another job during this 
time, and you gain a +2 bonus to your Perception 
checks while traveling through the wild or over long 
distances.. 
Favored Terrain : If you have the Favored Terrain (Ranger 2) 
power, the first bonus from the list above increases to a +10 
when on your favored terrain, and the second and third 
bonuses from the list above increase to a +5.

New Level 22 Utility Ranger 
Exploits/Evocations 
 
Beast Companion of 
Great Renown 
Ranger Utility 22 
Your beast companion is a legend in their own right, appearing on
banners and coat-of-arms, spreading both fear and a rallying point 
when appearing on the battlefield.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Beast, Renown, War 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have a medium or large beast 
companion.. 
Effect: Until the end of your next extended rest or until your 
beast companion dies, all allies get a +2 power bonus to 
their Intimidation checks against enemies to cause fear or 
their Diplomacy checks to inspire, as long as the targets can 
see or hear your beast companion and they are within 10 
squares of your beast companion. 
Renown: If you are using Renown rules, while under the 
effects of this power, your influence bonus from renown 
increases from a +2 to a +4. 
Warfare: If you are using Warfare rules, if you are in a warfare 
encounter, choose an allied unit. That unit gains a +4 influence 
bonus to Morale and Command checks if your beast 
companion is alive.  The effects of this power end at the end of 
that encounter. 
 
Carving the Terrain 
Ranger Utility 22 
You concentrate for a moment on the terrain ahead of you, then r
across the battlefield in a blink of an eye, using your blades to cut 
and shape the ground, trees, stone, and area in general to be mor
you and your allies' favor. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Weapon, 
Destruction 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 20 
Requirement : You must be wielding two melee weapons . 
Effect: You may change the shape of the blast into a rectangle 
of an equal number or lesser number of squares. It can't be 
more than 100 squares on a side. Until the end of your next 
turn, you may spend a move and a standard action to choose 
a number of squares equal to 1 + Dexterity modifier + 
Strength modifier, doubled. You may choose the same 
squares multiple times. For each square chosen, you may 
choose one of the following effects below to apply in it. 
Afterwards, you may teleport yourself to any empty square 
within but on the far side of the blast. 
+ 
If the square has difficult terrain caused by an object, 
you may remove it. It is destroyed or moved to 
another square in the area of effect. 
+ 
You may place difficult terrain in a square (such as 
by cutting up the ground or cutting an object and 
leaving debris there). 
+ 
You may remove an object causing a blocking 
obstacle ot terrain and reduce it to only causing 
difficult terrain. 
+ 
You may make an attack or Strength check against 
an object in that square. 
+ 
You may attack a creature in that square. If you are 
in combat, this attack has a -5 penalty unless the 
creature is helpless. 
 
 
 
Delayed Falling Arrow 
Ranger Utility 22 
You shoot an arrow into the sky with perfect predictive clarity. It h
a long fall down, making it easy to dodge but also making it easy t
hit or fall into objects, and making it difficult to tell who and where
came from. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Weapon 
Standard Action 
Ranged 1 mile (varies, see below) 
Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or crossbow. You 
must also be able to shoot straight up into the sky, such as 
when in the outdoors or in an outdoors -like area. 
Effect: You shoot an arrow into the sky, beyond seeing 
distance. At any point in the next hour, as long as you are still 
within a mile of where you shot the arrow and still outdoors, 
you may have the arrow from an origin point somewhere in 
the sky to any square ne ar you that you choose.  It does not 
have to be within line -of-sight, nor within line -of-sight or line-
of-effect of the original shot. 
 
If you choose to have it fall into a square with a 
creature, you may have it apply a basic ranged attack to the 
creature but it gets a -5 penalty. The attack does not seem to 
originate from you, and you can choose to have it appear to 
come from someone els e with a successful Bluff + 3 check vs 
passive Insight made by you or an ally. 
DM Notes: If the story takes place over wider distances, the 
DM is encouraged to increase the maximum distance of this 
power an extra 1, 2, or even 3 miles. If they want, they can 
use the excuse of an exceptionally clear day, low wind, or 
you are just that good. 
 
 
Gather Your Swarm 
Ranger Utility 22 
You send out your beast companion to gather a swarm of its own 
type to do your bidding, accomplishing non
-violent, but otherwise 
helpful tasks. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Beast, Wilderness, Binding 
Standard Action 
Ranged 20 
Prerequisite : You must have a small or tiny beast companion. 
Effect: You summon a swarm of creatures that are of a similar 
type to your beast companion and local to the area (if they 
exist) in an empty square within range. If you are in an area 
where your beast companion is local or a similar creature is, 
it will appear at the end of your next turn, otherwise, it may 
sometimes take up to an hour if it's possible at all. 
  
The swarm has similar stats as your beast 
companion, including the same keywords, movement 
abilities, skill bonuses, ability scores, resistances, 
vulnerabilities, senses, etc. However, it has triple the the 
health pool, a +4 to its Fortitude and Will defen ses, has 
resistance half damage to melee and ranged attacks, and 
vulnerability double damage from area and burst attacks. It 
takes up an area 2 times larger than the original creature, but 
can squeeze in any space one creature of the swarm can fit 
into. It also has a -10 penalty to Stealth checks. 
 
You can direct the swarm to do straightforward, 
simple tasks through giving directions to your animal 
companion. It will not attempt to interfere in combat, and will 
run away from situations it perceives as dangerous. It will stick 
around for 1 hour if not given a task or given a few short term 
tasks. If it is given a longer term task, it will stick around up to 
the end of your next extended rest to see it completed. If your 
beast companion is killed or knocked unconscious, the swarm 
will dissipate and leav e.

Carving the Terrain
Ranger Utility 22
You concentrate for a moment on the terrain ahead of you, then r
across the battlefield in a blink of an eye, using your blades to cut
and shape the ground, trees, stone, and area in general to be mor
you and your allies' favor.
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Weapon,
Destruction
Standard Action
Close Burst 20
Requirement : You must be wielding two melee weapons .
Effect: You may change the shape of the blast into a rectangle
of an equal number or lesser number of squares. It can't be
more than 100 squares on a side. Until the end of your next
turn, you may spend a move and a standard action to choose
a number of squares equal to 1 + Dexterity modifier +
Strength modifier, doubled. You may choose the same
squares multiple times. For each square chosen, you may
choose one of the following effects below to apply in it.
Afterwards, you may teleport yourself to any empty square
within but on the far side of the blast.
+
If the square has difficult terrain caused by an object,
you may remove it. It is destroyed or moved to
another square in the area of effect.
+
You may place difficult terrain in a square (such as
by cutting up the ground or cutting an object and
leaving debris there).
+
You may remove an object causing a blocking
obstacle ot terrain and reduce it to only causing
difficult terrain.
+
You may make an attack or Strength check against
an object in that square.
+
You may attack a creature in that square. If you are
in combat, this attack has a -5 penalty unless the
creature is helpless.
Delayed Falling Arrow
Ranger Utility 22
You shoot an arrow into the sky with perfect predictive clarity. It h
a long fall down, making it easy to dodge but also making it easy t
hit or fall into objects, and making it difficult to tell who and where
came from.
Daily + Non-Combat, Martial, Wilderness, Weapon
Standard Action
Ranged 1 mile (varies, see below)
Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or crossbow. You
must also be able to shoot straight up into the sky, such as
when in the outdoors or in an outdoors -like area.
Effect: You shoot an arrow into the sky, beyond seeing
distance. At any point in the next hour, as long as you are still
within a mile of where you shot the arrow and still outdoors,
you may have the arrow from an origin point somewhere in
the sky to any square ne ar you that you choose. It does not
have to be within line -of-sight, nor within line -of-sight or line-
of-effect of the original shot.
If you choose to have it fall into a square with a
creature, you may have it apply a basic ranged attack to the
creature but it gets a -5 penalty. The attack does not seem to
originate from you, and you can choose to have it appear to
come from someone els e with a successful Bluff + 3 check vs
passive Insight made by you or an ally.
DM Notes: If the story takes place over wider distances, the
DM is encouraged to increase the maximum distance of this
power an extra 1, 2, or even 3 miles. If they want, they can
use the excuse of an exceptionally clear day, low wind, or
you are just that good.
Gather Your Swarm
Ranger Utility 22
You send out your beast companion to gather a swarm of its own
type to do your bidding, accomplishing non
-violent, but otherwise
helpful tasks.
Daily + Non-Combat, Beast, Wilderness, Binding
Standard Action
Ranged 20
Prerequisite : You must have a small or tiny beast companion.
Effect: You summon a swarm of creatures that are of a similar
type to your beast companion and local to the area (if they
exist) in an empty square within range. If you are in an area
where your beast companion is local or a similar creature is,
it will appear at the end of your next turn, otherwise, it may
sometimes take up to an hour if it's possible at all.
The swarm has similar stats as your beast
companion, including the same keywords, movement
abilities, skill bonuses, ability scores, resistances,
vulnerabilities, senses, etc. However, it has triple the the
health pool, a +4 to its Fortitude and Will defen ses, has
resistance half damage to melee and ranged attacks, and
vulnerability double damage from area and burst attacks. It
takes up an area 2 times larger than the original creature, but
can squeeze in any space one creature of the swarm can fit
into. It also has a -10 penalty to Stealth checks.
You can direct the swarm to do straightforward,
simple tasks through giving directions to your animal
companion. It will not attempt to interfere in combat, and will
run away from situations it perceives as dangerous. It will stick
around for 1 hour if not given a task or given a few short term
tasks. If it is given a longer term task, it will stick around up to
the end of your next extended rest to see it completed. If your
beast companion is killed or knocked unconscious, the swarm
will dissipate and leav e.

New Level 2 Utility Rogue Exploits
 
Looming Thug 
Rogue Utility 2 
You stand behind someone, making them feel surrounded and 
more scared. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, gain a +1 bonus to 
your next Intimidation check. If you are behind the target 
you want to intimidate, and an ally of yours who is also 
trying to intimidate them is in front of them, both you and 
that ally get a +2 bonus to their Intimidation check 
instead. 
 
Charming Rapscallion 
Rogue Utility 2 
You've charmed your way past more marks than you can count,
turning wary strangers into fast friends with little more than a 
grin and a good story. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Social, Deception 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have training in Diplomacy or Bluff. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, gain a +1 bonus to 
your next Bluff or Diplomacy check to persuade, sell 
something, or increase the impression or favorability 
someone has of you. If this is the first time you've met this 
NPC ever, the bonus increases to a +3. If you have ever 
done a negative action against this creature (tricked, 
swindled, cheated, stolen from, attacked, etc) and they 
recognize you, then you cannot use this power on them. 
 
Investigative Mind 
Rogue Utility 2 
You see the hints of something here, and direct your sights to 
where the clues tell you something should be.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Gathering Information 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must have training in Perception. 
Effect: Make a Perception check with a bonus equal to your 
Intelligence modifier. 
 
Stance of the Bone 
Crushing Thug 
Rogue Utility 2 
You sacrifice speed for the terrifying gait of a ruthless killer, 
sizing up your enemy's weakest bones and veins as you approac
them. 
Daily + Combat, Martial, Stance 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: While in this stance, your speed is reduced by 1. But, 
you deal an extra die of sneak attack damage when 
wielding a club or mace. In addition, when a weapon 
attack you make with a club or mace deals damage to a 
rattled enemy, it deals extra damage equal t o your 
Strength modifier. You may leave and enter this stance 
until the end of this encounter with a minor action.

New Level 6 Utility Rogue Exploits
 
 
Cunning Advice 
Rogue Utility 6 
You are able to aid allies from afar just by giving good advice or
good plan of action. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Social 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be trained in a skill. 
Target: One ally that can hear you, understands your 
language, and is within line of sight. 
Effect: Roll an Aid Another check to aid the target ally with 
a skill you are trained in, against a DC of 10 + half the 
level of the creature you are aiding + 2. If you succeed, 
they gain a +2 bonus to their next check with that same 
skill until the end of the en counter. Cunning Sneak: You 
may add your Intelligence modifier as the bonus instead of 
the +2. 
 
 
Evasive Trap Sense 
Rogue Utility 6 
Some instinct screams “move!”
—and you do, ducking the trap 
before it fully bites. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Exploration 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You are hit by a trap or hazard attack. 
Target: The triggering trap or hazard. 
Effect: The target rerolls its attack against you. You gain a 
+4 bonus to all your defenses against that specific attack. 
 
 
I Know a Guy Who 
Knows a Guy 
Rogue Utility 6 
You may not know how to do the thing, but you know someone
who does. “Translating an ancient text? No idea. But a professo
at the local university probably could, and I know how to get 
there.” 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Gathering Information, Urban 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: Make a Streetwise check with a +3 bonus to find a 
type of person who can get you a piece of information. If 
you succeed, you also learn their general or usual location 
and how to get there. 
 
 
Modify Item Quality 
Appearance 
Rogue Utility 6 
You make something look more decrepit, new, or mundane than
it actually is. 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Deception, Restoration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be wielding a Disguise Kit, a 
Forgery Kit, or a kit relevant to the item you are modifying 
(such as Blacksmith’s Tools if modifying a weapon or 
armor, or Carpenter’s Tools if modifying something 
wooden). 
Effect: Choose one of the following effects: 
  
New: Make the target object seem new and 
unblemished, masking any flaws, age, breakage, or 
imperfections. Using a broken object for its purpose 
reveals its true state. Creatures familiar with that type of 
object can attempt a saving throw when they first inter act 
with the object to overcome the disguise, and every hour 
thereafter that they continue to interact with it. 
  
Decrepit: Make the target object seem like a 
worthless, aged, useless, rusting, or otherwise decrepit 
version of itself. Using an object that seems broken for its 
purpose reveals its true state. Creatures familiar with that 
type of object can attempt a saving throw when they first 
interact with the object to overcome the disguise, and 
every hour thereafter that they continue to interact with it. 
  
Mundane: Make an object that is especially 
interesting or blemished appear like a mundane, 
unremarkable version of itself; a magical longsword seems 
ordinary, a broken spear looks like every other on the rack, 
a long-unused throne seems standard. Interacting with the 
object directly reveals its true state immediately if it is 
magical; otherwise the user gets a saving throw to discover 
the disguise. 
 
 
Must Have Been the 
Wind 
Rogue Utility 6 
You mess up and make a sound, but on their way to check on yo
others simply find a cat, a window someone must have left open
or something else innocuous. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Deception, Exploration 
Immediate Reaction 
Personal 
Requirement: You are out of combat. 
Trigger: You fail a Stealth check against creatures that are 
not aware of you, can’t see you, and whose line of sight 
you are not within. 
Effect: You may reroll the Stealth check. You must use the 
second result. If the roll succeeds in hiding you, you may 
then immediately move up to your speed + 2 to another 
location that you can hide behind or in. You are hidden 
during and after this move. 
 
 
Nothing Up My Sleeve 
Rogue Utility 6 
A knife is only as good as your ability to have it when they 
thought they took everything.
 
Daily (Special) + Non-Combat, Deception, Martial 
Practice 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: You hide any number of weapons on your person so 
that they cannot be found. Make a Thievery check with a 
+10 bonus. The next time you are searched for one of the 
following weapons, the searcher must beat a Perception 
check equal to your Thievery check res ult to find it. The 
weapons must be small, one -handed, and one of the 
following categories: dagger, shuriken, or sling (but not its 
ammunition). 
Special: You can use this power twice before each extended 
rest. Whenever it is used a second time after an extended 
rest, you may choose to keep the Thievery check result 
you got the first time instead of rolling again.

Practice
Standard Action
Personal

that they cannot be found. Make a Thievery check with a
+10 bonus. The next time you are searched for one of the
following weapons, the searcher must beat a Perception
check equal to your Thievery check res ult to find it. The
weapons must be small, one -handed, and one of the
following categories: dagger, shuriken, or sling (but not its

Ranged Distraction 
Rogue Utility 6 
A pebble skips off a far wall, a crate rattles in the dark
—every eye 
snaps the wrong way, and that’s all you need.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Deception, Exploration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be wielding a crossbow, sling, or 
thrown weapon. 
Effect: Choose a square within range of your weapon. 
Nearby creatures that you are hidden from hear a noise or 
disturbance coming from that square. If enemies choose to 
face that area, this counts as enough of a distraction to 
enable you and allies who are behind those enemies to 
make a Stealth check even if they are not behind full cover 
or total concealment (as per the distraction part of the 
Stealth rules). Enemies close enough to hear the noise take 
a -2 penalty to Perception checks to perceive other 
creatures until they move to that square or see you or an 
ally trying to hide. 
 
 
Secret Speech (Rogue) 
Rogue Utility 6 
With pre-established codewords, you and your crew are able to 
have an entirely different conversation than the one the people
around you hear. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Deception, Social 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must be trained in Bluff. 
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can send secret 
messages embedded in normal speech to allies in the 
nearby area who can hear you and understand your 
language. You must have had at least one long rest with 
an ally for them to understand you. Delivering a secret 
message generally takes twice as long as the message 
would otherwise take to relay. If an enemy becomes 
aware you are sending secret messages in your normal 
speech, they can try to figure it out with an Insight check 
vs. DC 10 + your current bonu s to Bluff checks. 
 
Threats Come True 
Rogue Utility 6 
Like a proper thug, you are not only good at making threats, bu
you are good at realizing them. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Social 
No Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You are not in combat. 
Trigger: You succeeded on an Intimidate check against a 
creature or group of creatures you’ve been talking to for at 
least 1 minute. 
Effect: If you roll initiative to enter a combat encounter 
against any of the triggering creatures before your next 
extended rest, all of the triggering creatures that are in 
that encounter as an enemy are rattled until the end of 
their first turn. Ruthless Ruffian: Targeted enemies also 
take a -2 penalty to their initiative check.

Underworld Contact 
Rogue Utility 6 
Everyone you ever ran with left a door cracked open somewhere
You still know which ones to knock on.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Gathering Information, Urban, 
Social 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: Make a Streetwise check with a bonus equal to the 
higher of your Intelligence modifier or +2 to reach out to 
an old contact in the area. Depending on the result, you 
find them if able, or you easily learn whether they’ve 
moved on from the area. A result b elow 10 means you 
can’t find or access them this time. When you use this 
power, determine whether you are asking for a favor or for 
knowledge; it must relate to their purview.

on your past. Diplomacy and similar social rolls to 
convince them gain a modifier based on the Social Mod of 
the check result (in addition to DM modifiers for the 
favor’s nature and size). You may raise their Influ ence / 
Access one row, but the Social Mod worsens by a further -

improve during play by doing favors for the NPC.

own stats to see if the contact can answer your question; if 
they can, gain a bonus to your next knowledge check 
while talking to them, as long as it is information they 
would reasonably know (often set by the Influence / 
Access column).

past as a rogue? Here are some examples of some

power: a comrade from a guild (thieves’ or 
assassins’), a fence, a smuggler, an old boss, a 
former henchman, a corr
upt guard who was on 
the take, an upright guard who used to arrest you

hobo or beggar, etc. 
 
 
Cunning Improvisation 
Rogue Utility 6 
A loose flagstone, a swinging blade, a patch of oil
—you see not a 
hazard but an opportunity waiting to be pointed the right way.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Combat, Exploration 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: Choose a trap, hazard, or terrain power in the area. If 
the chosen trap, hazard, or terrain power can’t affect 
enemies, you become aware of this and you regain the use 
of this power. Otherwise, until your next short or extended 
rest, the next time that trap, hazard, or terrain power 
would target a creature, it gains a +2 bonus or takes a -2 
penalty to its attack roll (your choice). If it hits, you may 
have it deal extra damage equal to your Sneak Attack. 
Artful Dodger: You may increase the damage dealt by your 
Charisma modifier. Cunning Sneak: You may increase the 
attack bonus and the damage dealt by your Intelligence 
modifier.

New Level 10 Utility Rogue Exploits
 
 
Artful Wound 
Rogue Utility 10 
You impress or terrify by throwing with such accuracy as to 
purposefully graze your target. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Social, Weapon 
Standard Action 
Ranged Weapon 
Requirement: You must be wielding a crossbow or thrown 
weapon (light blade, axe, or spear only). 
Target: One creature. 
Attack: Dexterity vs AC 
Hit: Deal 1 damage, but the next Intimidate check made by 
you against the target or its watching allies gains a +5 
bonus until the end of your next turn. You can instead 
choose to grant that bonus to a Diplomacy or similar 
check, as part of a performance to am aze or impress the 
target or a watching audience. This damage cannot reduce 
the target to 0 or fewer hit points. 
 
Miss: Deal 1[W] damage. If this unexpectedly initiates 
combat, you take a -2 penalty to your attack rolls during the 
first round. 
 
 
Equipment Review 
Rogue Utility 10 
A professional doesn’t blame their tools, but they know they are
only as good as them. You take the time during a break to revie
clean, organize, and improve your tools.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Rest, Restoration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be taking a short or extended rest. 
Effect: Choose an equipment or tool kit that you or an ally 
resting with you has. If it grants any equipment bonuses to 
skills, it grants an additional +2 bonus to those skill checks 
with that tool until your next short or extended rest. 
 
 
Making a Plan 
Rogue Utility 10 
You sit your crew down to mastermind a plan for them, crafting
a plan that if executed exactly as you say can hardly fail.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Rest, Social, Exploration, Physical 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be taking a short or extended rest. 
Target: You and any number of allies resting with you who 
are not currently using another rest ability. 
Effect: For each target, choose a skill or ability check and a 
specific activity or use for that check, then give that target 
a d4 Plan die. Until the end of your next extended rest, the 
target can roll the Plan die and add both it and your 
Intelligence modifier to any check they make that matches 
the skill or ability and the specific use you chose for them, 
or to an Aid Another check when helping another 
character make that same check for that same use. 
Examples: Athletics and swimming or climbing, Acrobatics 
and balancing or squeezing, Stealth and moving quietly or 
hiding, Thievery and picking locks or pickpocketing, Bluff 
and lying or Bluff and disguise. 
 
 
Sabotage Trap 
Rogue Utility 10 
A few simple modifications is all it takes to cause an enemy to 
stumble into the same trap they set up. “Something has change
they think, as they hear the familiar click before the blade come
swinging down. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Exploration, Destruction 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must be trained in Thievery. 
Requirement: You must have a trap -making kit. 
Target: One trap or hazard. 
Effect: Make a Thievery check against the DC to disable the 
target trap or hazard, or against a DC of your level + 10 if 
it does not have one. If you succeed and the target trap or 
hazard does not trigger on or target enemies, a specific 
creature, or a type of creature, you change it so that it now 
does, and so that it does not target you or your allies. If it is 
a trap, you may also change the type of damage it deals 
from one type to another. If you fail, you gain a +2 bonus 
to the next skill check you make to tr y to disable that trap 
or hazard. 
 
 
Unexpected KO 
Rogue Utility 10 
One clean strike behind the ear, and they simply fold. Nobody 
hears a thing. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Deception, Weapon 
Standard Action 
Melee or Ranged Weapon 
Requirement: You must be wielding a club, a mace, or a 
sling or thrown weapon (flail or hammer only). You cannot 
be in combat. 
Target: One non -Elite, non-Solo creature that is at least 3 
levels below you and that is not aware of your presence. 
Attack: Dexterity vs AC. If the target is a minion, this attack 
automatically succeeds. 
Hit: The creature is knocked unconscious. This lasts for 1 
hour, until another creature wakes it with a standard 
action, or until it is dealt damage. If this was a melee 
attack and you were not revealed to other enemies when 
using this power, you regain the us e of this power. It can 
only be regained twice this way. 
Level 22: At level 22, this power can last up to 8 hours for 
creatures below level 10. And you can regain it up to four 
times this way. 
 
 
 
My Tools of Pain 
Rogue Utility 10 
You turn the weapon over in your hands where they can see it, 
and let them imagine the rest. They know what you can do with
it. Or they will soon. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Combat, Social, Fear 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus 
to your next Intimidate check if you have a light blade, 
club, or mace. If your weapon counts as both a light blade 
and a mace, the bonus increases to +4 instead. Combat: If 
you successfully attack an o pponent with a light blade, 
club, or mace you are wielding with a weapon attack, this 
power can be used as an immediate reaction that turn and 
the bonus increases to +5. Ruthless Ruffian: If that attack 
used a club or mace, it also deals 5 extra damage.

New Level 16 Utility Rogue Exploits
 
 
 
 
Dramatic Disappearance 
Rogue Utility 16 
“We’re going to want to enter from there,” they say, pointing a
window. “Consider it done,” they hear you reply behind them. 
“But how will you…?” But when they turn around to finish the 
question, you’re already gone, as if you were never there.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Deception, Exploration 
Free Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You are out of combat. 
Trigger: All non -PC creatures you are interacting with in the 
area are distracted, or are turned away and not looking at 
you for any reason. 
Target: All triggering creatures. 
Effect: Make a Stealth check with a +2 bonus against the 
highest passive Perception among the creatures you are 
interacting with. If you succeed, you may quietly move up 
to twice your speed. You must end this movement 
somewhere you can hide, at which point you 
automatically become hidden from all targets. You gain a 
+2 bonus to all skill checks to jump, climb, or swim during 
this movement. If you cannot end this movement in a 
position to hide, you are assumed not to have moved in 
the first place, and you regain th e use of this power. 
Although the targets do not detect you leaving, and may 
even be in the middle of a sentence, you get the gist of the 
rest of their thought as if you had stayed there listening to 
them. 
 
 
 
Evasive Parkour 
Rogue Utility 16 
Every rooftop, railing, and rain barrel is a door out. Whoever is 
behind you has to take the long way.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Physical, Exploration 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must be trained in Athletics or 
Acrobatics. 
Effect: Gain a +5 bonus to Athletics and/or Acrobatics skill 
checks, whichever you’re trained in, during skill checks or 
skill challenges related to chases, hunting, or tracking as 
long as you are the pursued. This effect lasts for the next 5 
minutes or until the end of the encounter. 
 
 
Impenetrable Lie 
Rogue Utility 16 
Lying is so ingrained in you that people can’t get the truth from 
you even when you are magically compelled or your mind is rea 
Daily + Non-Combat, Deception, Warding 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must be trained in Bluff. 
Effect: For the next 1 hour, you cannot be compelled to 
speak the truth, nor can your mind be read, by any 
external effect. In addition, any bonuses to Insight checks 
against you, or penalties to your Bluff checks, from powers, 
items, or rituals are negated. You can choose whether the 
caster of these abilities knows that it failed or still thinks 
they succeeded. 
 
 
Skillful Resurgence 
Rogue Utility 16 
A trick you thought you’d spent comes back to you the moment
you need it again. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Restoration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: You regain an expended encounter Non -Combat 
utility power of level 10 or lower. It must be a skill power 
or a rogue power.

New Level 22 Utility Rogue Exploits
 
 
 
Greater Skillful 
Resurgence 
Rogue Utility 22 
With a bit of focus and concentration, you are able to repeat 
unbelievable acts that may have been a fluke before.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Restoration, Martial Practice 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 1 minute. 
Effect: You regain an expended Non -Combat utility power 
of level 16 or lower. It must be a class, racial, or skill 
power and cannot have any of the following power source 
keywords: Arcane, Divine, Shadow, Primal, or Psionic. It 
also cannot have the Combat keyword . 
 
 
Master of Disguise 
(Rogue) 
Rogue Utility 22 
The guards rush in. “Give up! You’re surrounded.” Suddenly, one
of the guards takes out a knife and places it on the throat of a 
different. Looks like they’re not so surrounded after all.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Deception 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must have a Disguise Kit on your person. 
You are hidden from anyone who could see and you are 
not in combat. You must also have at least 1 healing surge 
and 1 action point. 
Effect: Spend 1 healing surge. You are removed from play 
for at least 1 hour. After that, at any point during play that 
is either outside of combat or as initiative is being rolled, 
you may spend 1 action point to choose a nameless filler 
NPC or minion enemy (ran dom cultist #5, city guard who 
comes to investigate you breaking into a house, shop 
keep’s assistant, etc.) in the scene and reveal that they are 
actually you in disguise. 
You can remain in this out -of-play state as long as you 
choose, up to the next time initiative is rolled for a combat 
encounter. If you have still not revealed yourself by that 
point and there are no valid disguise targets, the DM must 
introduce a valid NP C to the scene for you to reveal 
yourself as by the end of the first round of combat. 
Special: This can only be used once per level. 
DM Note: The DM may choose to expand the things you 
can disguise yourself as, such as named NPCs, non -minion 
enemies, etc. In addition, replaced NPCs are often 
assumed to be knocked out somewhere and may appear 
again in a later encounter. 
 
 
 
Zephyr’s Parkour 
Rogue Utility 22 
You stand still and read the route like a page 
- every ledge, gap, 
and handhold, in order. Then you simply go, and nothing 
between here and there gets a vote.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Physical, Exploration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You are out of combat. 
Effect: Choose a spot within line of sight and within 4 times 
your speed. You take one full turn to breathe, focus, and 
identify your route. Next turn, you may use a move action 
to move to the spot you chose, and are assumed to 
succeed on every check required to reach that spot 
(examples: climbing, jumping, balancing, etc.). If it is 
impossible to reach that square even with rolling 20s on 
all your checks, you gain that knowledge and regain the 
use of this power, but the action is still expended.

88 
 
 
Planning the Operation 
Rogue Utility 22 
You spend the downtime asking the worst question you know: 
what if it all goes wrong? By the time you move, every answer is
already in your pocket. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Combat, Rest 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be taking a short or extended rest. 
Effect: You gain the secondary power Backup Plan 
Flashback (Short) or Backup Plan Flashback (Extended) 
respectively. You can use it at any point until your next 
short or extended rest respectively, a number of times 
depending on when you used this power: once for a short 
rest, three times for an extended rest. 
Special: If this power is used during an extended rest, you 
do not regain it during your next extended rest. 
 
 
 
Backup Plan Flashback 
(Short) 
Rogue Utility 22 
You spend the downtime asking the worst question you know: 
what if it all goes wrong? By the time you move, every answer is
already in your pocket. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Combat 
Free Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You have the Planning the Operation power 
and used it during a short rest. 
Effect: The current scene is paused, and you trigger a short 
flashback scene back to when you were making this plan 
during the short rest in which you used Planning the 
Operation. Establish in the fiction one bit of preparation 
you and/or your PC allies made just in case you ran into 
the present situation. It must be a limited change - one 
that you could have accomplished in 5 or 10 minutes. 
Afterwards, when you return back to the present scene, the 
next attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check 
of you or an ally that benefits from the change you made 
to the fiction gains a bonus equal to your Intelligence 
modifier until the end of the encounter (or until 5 minutes 
ends). 
 
Backup Plan Flashback 
(Extended) 
Rogue Utility 22 
You spend the downtime asking the worst question you know: 
what if it all goes wrong? By the time you move, every answer is
already in your pocket. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Combat 
Free Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You have the Planning the Operation power 
and used it during an extended rest. 
Effect: The current scene is paused, and you trigger a short 
flashback scene back to when you were making this plan 
during the extended rest in which you used Planning the 
Operation. Establish in the fiction one bit of preparation 
you and/or your PC allies made j ust in case you ran into 
the present situation. It can be a fairly flexible change, 
something that you could have accomplished during the 
extended rest, or during any of the hours of downtime you 
had directly before or after. 
In addition, the next check or roll you or the targeted ally 
makes that was triggered by the change made to the 
fiction gets a -2 penalty, plus an additional -2 penalty for 
every time this power was used since your last extended 
rest. 
If it’s wildly unrealistic that your character would have 
expected this situation, the DM may require a related type 
of knowledge roll or Intelligence check. You may add your 
Intelligence modifier to this roll or check. If that check 
fails, this power fails and can’t be used until you leave the 
scene or encounter, but this power is also not expended. 
 
Planning the Operation Examples
 
+ Execute the Backup Plan (Short) 
Examples: You performed a ritual that 
would have helped, you contacted an ally 
you should have contacted who could 
arrive quickly or you could contact 
quickly for information, you changed 
your equipment setup or maybe some 
players traded items, you dropped or hid 
something nearby, etc. 
+ Execute the Backup Plan (Extended) 
Examples: You contacted an ally who 
may take some time to get there or 
would take you some time to contact, 
you bought some items from a shop, you 
performed a longer ritual that could help 
in the present situation, you did some 
research or found new information fro
m 
a contact, you dropped something in a 
place, paid off someone, etc.

New Level 2 Utility Warlord Exploits
 
 
 
Ambush Captain 
Warlord Utility 2 
You sketch out a quick plan or give some quick tips on a path to
take, then send everyone on their way to execute the surprise 
attack. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Travel, Stance, Martial Practice, 
Battle Preparation 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 5 
Requirement: You are out of combat. Also, at least you and 
one of your allies are hidden from an enemy you are 
aware of. 
Cast Time: 1 minute 
Target: You and your allies within the initial burst. 
Effect: The target gets a +2 bonus to Stealth checks, as long 
as this stance is active and they are within a mile of you. If 
the target rolls for initiative for a combat encounter while 
in this stance, they gain a +2 bonus to initiative and their 
attacks deal +1d6 extra damage during the Surprise 
Round (if there is one). If more than one target is spotted 
while you are in this stance, it ends. 
 
Bird Calls 
Warlord Utility 2 
A whistle here, a warble there 
— a private language hidden in the 
ordinary sounds of the wild. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Wilderness, Rest 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must currently be taking a short or 
extended rest in an area with local wildlife that makes 
sounds. 
Effect: You establish a set of signals that you and any allies 
resting with you understand. Choose up to 10 different 
signals and the message or phrase they are trying to 
communicate. They sound exactly like the local wildlife. 
You can make such sounds without mak ing a check, and 
they can be heard up to 1000 feet away. After hearing it, 
an ally can make a Medium DC Nature or Perception 
check to determine your general distance away and 
direction. Your allies that were resting with you when you 
used this power must m ake a Nature check based on your 
level - Easy if the area has a lot of low level wildlife, or a 
Medium Nature check if it has barely any or only high level 
wildlife - in order to gain access to the same calls. You and 
your allies can use these calls to mak e these signals until 
the next time you use this power, although they are only 
useful while near the current environment. 
Per the DM's prerogative, dense, forested areas, noisy wind, 
or other similar areas that can shorten sound may shorten 
the distance it can be heard up to half. Optimal conditions, 
such as an open area with soft wind to carry sound, or an 
echoing space, may increase the distance the calls can be 
heard up to 1 mile. 
 
 
Bird Call Signal Examples
 
Some example signals you and your allies might 
establish: “Danger”, “Help!”, “Come back quick!”, 
“Run away!”, “All clear”, “Enemy spotted, move 
in”, “Enemy spotted, hide.” 
 
 
Improvised 
Distraction 
Warlord Utility 2 
A good officer never lets a slip become a disaster 
— you draw the 
enemy's attention onto yourself so your people can melt back in
the dark. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Exploration, Deception 
Immediate 
Reaction 
Personal 
Trigger: You or an ally fails a Stealth check. 
Effect: You and all other allies that aren't the triggered 
creature gain a +1 bonus to Stealth checks this turn and 
until the end of your next turn. If it was part of a group 
Stealth check or Skill Challenge, it's a +2 bonus instead. 
 
 
Intimidating Stunt 
Warlord Utility 2 
You stun and terrify onlookers with your risky and brave 
maneuvers. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Social, Physical 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You succeed a Medium or Hard skill check that 
involves Strength or Dexterity, or use such a skill check to 
bypass difficult or hindering terrain, or a similar danger. 
Effect: You may make an immediate Intimidation check 
with a +2 bonus (even if it would normally take a standard 
action). 
 
 
Mind for Maps 
Warlord Utility 2 
Every road, ridge, and old battlefield you've ever studied is filed
away in your head, ready the moment you need it.
 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Exploration, Travel, War 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus 
to History skill checks for military history, wars, battles, 
grand strategy, etc. In addition, this bonus also applies to 
skill checks related to geography or navigation (often 
Nature or Dungeoneering).

pages.rawText:
92 
 
 
Natural Leader 
Warlord Utility 2 
People look to you when things fall apart 
— a steady word from 
you turns a frightened crowd into a functioning team.
 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, gain a +2 bonus to 
Diplomacy skill checks when directing or giving orders to 
an NPC if they are not unfriendly to you. If the target NPC 
is experiencing a moment of crisis or panic, the bonus 
increases to a +4. 
 
 
Pre-Battle Rituals 
Warlord Utility 2 
Before a big battle, you have your own rituals of preparation, 
whether it's a quiet contemplation or a loud hyping yourself up.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Battle Preparation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be taking a short or extended rest. 
Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your 
Charisma or Wisdom modifier until the end of the first 
turn of your next combat encounter (or at the beginning of 
your next short or extended rest). 
Bravura: The temporary hit points instead last until the end 
of your next combat encounter. 
 
 
Running Cadence 
Warlord Utility 2 
You set a marching chant that keeps everyone's feet moving lon
after they'd normally drop. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Travel 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: You and your allies may make a DC 20 Endurance 
check to continue traveling overland at a fast pace beyond 
1 hour. If you fail, you must spend a healing surge or take 
damage equal to your level as normal. The DC increases 
by 5 every hour after that. In addi tion, if you or an ally 
would take damage from this, they take only half the 
damage instead. 
 
 
Setup Camp Quickly 
Warlord Utility 2 
You've spent so much camped out for war, that by the time you
buddies have taken off their armor and sat down, you have 
already assembled the campsite. And you can tear it down with
equal speed. 
At-Will + Non -Combat, Travel, Rest, Martial Practice 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 5 minutes (setup), 1 minute (teardown) 
Effect: You can use this power to quickly setup or teardown 
a campsite during the cast time. When setting one up, you 
clear the area, set up tents, unroll bedrolls, create a fire if 
you have a way to do so, and setup buckets and pans for 
whoever gathers the water and cooks the food. When 
tearing one down, you teardown and pack up the tents, 
pack up the supplies, put out the fire, and clear the area as 
if you were never there. You use you and your allies' 
existing gear when setting up the camp. 
 
 
 
 
Study the Battlefield 
Warlord Utility 2 
You see a barrel of Dwarven Fire Whiskey and remember the 
history of the brew and the rumors of it's numerous explosive 
accidents. You smile to yourself as you think that it's time for a 
little fireworks. 
At-Will + Non -Combat, Gathering Information, Battle 
Preparation 
Free Action 
Personal 
Effect: You get a +2 bonus to Perception checks to identify 
key features of a battlefield and a bonus to skill checks to 
identify what they are, except for traps. This includes 
facets of the terrain, hazards, possible terrain powers, 
illusions on the terrain, etc. 
 
 
Study the Battlefield DM Notes
 
The DM can add a +2 to identify traps or aspects 
of traps if someone uses this power on them and 
the DM doesn’t want to give away that it’s a trap.
 
 
 
Tactical Knowledge 
Warlord Utility 2 
You read the flow of a fight the way others read a book 
— where 
the line will break, who's about to flank, what the enemy wants
 
Encounter + Non -Combat, War 
Free Action 
Personal 
Effect: Gain a +3 bonus to the roll of a Tactics skill if you 
have it. If you do not, gain a +2 bonus to a similar skill or 
ability check (often Insight or Intelligence). 
Special: When you select this power, if the DM allows, you 
gain a new skill called Tactics (Int) if yo su don't already 
have it. It can be used to read what enemies are planning 
to do next, how they fight, how an enemy squad or 
military runs, spotting weaknesses in enemies or the 
environment, etc. It can also be used as a monster 
knowledge roll for enemy hum anoids that fight in groups.

Tactical Retreat 
Warlord Utility 2 
You see that there is no winning the situation and are able to 
execute a more effective retreat to save your people.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: You or an ally must lose 1 healing surge. The DM 
interrupts the combat encounter with a skill challenge. 
The skill challenge is created with the players; together 
you all decide its goal. The negative consequence for 
losing is generally just resuming the combat, though often 
in a different place farther away from the initial battle, 
depending on how many successful checks the party got 
before they failed the skill challenge. 
The difficulty of the skill challenge is dependent on the 
difference in level between the players and the enemies; 
the DCs of the checks themselves are dependent on the 
level of the highest enemy. The players escape far enough 
away to take a short rest if they succeed. The DM is free to 
adjust the difficulty of the skill challenge depending on 
other enemy factors as well.

New Level 6 Utility Warlord Exploits
 
 
 
Advice on Giving 
Advice 
Warlord Utility 6 
You improve the leadership or mentorship skills of someone else
so that you all can benefit from their wisdom together.
 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Social 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 100 
Target: One ally who can hear you and understand your 
language. 
Effect: The target may choose an ally of theirs who can hear 
them and understand their language. The next time this 
encounter that the chosen ally makes an Aid Another 
check to aid the target, that Aid Another check grants a 
+4 bonus instead of the usual +2. 
 
Catch Them! 
Warlord Utility 6 
You lunge to catch a comrade before the ground 
— or the enemy 
— can claim them. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Physical 
Immediate 
Interrupt 
Ranged 5 
Trigger: An ally is falling, or is pushed, pulled, slid, or 
knocked prone. 
Target: An ally within 5 squares of the triggering ally. 
Effect: The target moves up to their speed to a square 
adjacent to the triggering ally. If the triggering ally is 
falling, they land on the targeted ally and both take half of 
any falling damage. Otherwise, reduce the number of 
squares they are being pushed, pulle d, or slid by 1. If they 
would be knocked prone from falling or the forced 
movement effect, they are not. 
 
Delegate Skill 
Challenge 
Warlord Utility 6 
You ask an ally to take the lead during their moment of expertis
to quickly and smoothly accomplish your whole team's goals.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Social, Physical 
No Action 
Personal 
Trigger: It is your turn to take an action during a skill 
challenge. 
Effect: You may have an ally make an action during the skill 
challenge instead. This doesn't count as their action for the 
round. They get a +1 bonus to any skill checks they make 
during that action. 
 
When Delegating Matters
 
This power earns its keep at tables where a skill 
challenge runs in rounds and every player is 
expected to act before the next round begins 
— 
handing your action to an ally is a real concession 
of the spotlight. If your skill challenges are looser, 
with pl ayers contributing whenever they have an 
idea, it does much less work. 
 
 
 
Find Traps 
Warlord Utility 6 
“Well, I’d know that I would trap this area if I was them…”
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Exploration, Martial, Zone 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 10 
Effect: You create a zone around you that follows you as you 
move until the end of your next turn. You are able to 
detect if a trap is within this zone and within your line of 
sight, but not the exact location of it. It must be specifically 
intended to cause harm by its creator (so natural hazards 
don’t count). This power merely reveals that a trap is 
present in the zone. You don’t learn the location of each 
trap, but you do learn the general nature of the danger 
posed by a trap you sense. 
Sustain Minor: The power sustains. 
 
Forced March 
Cadence 
Warlord Utility 6 
You sing a song while marching along to force your allies to kee
going when they would normally tire out. “I don’t know what I’v
been told!” 
Daily + Non -Combat, Travel 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: Until the end of the day, you and your allies gain a +5 
bonus to Endurance checks to walk or run for long periods 
of time. In addition, the DC does not increase by 5 after 
the first hour when walking beyond 10 hours in a day. You 
and your allies’ encumbran ce carrying capacity doubles 
during this time. 
 
Friendly Advice 
Warlord Utility 6 
A word in the right ear at the right moment 
— you’ve always 
known how to steer a friend true.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Social 
Immediate 
Reaction 
Ranged 5 
Trigger: An ally within range that you can see or hear makes 
a skill check using a skill in which you have a positive 
bonus. This must be used before you know the result. 
Effect: Grant the ally the ability to reroll the skill check, with 
a power bonus equal to the higher of your Intelligence or 
Wisdom modifier if you are trained in that skill. If you are 
not trained in that skill, they get a power bonus equal to 
your Charisma modif ier - 2. 
 
Grab Them 
Warlord Utility 6 
With a shout and a gesture, you get one of your soldiers to scoo
up a fallen comrade and keep moving.
 
At-Will + Non -Combat, Martial 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 20 
Target: One ally who can hear and understand you within 
the burst. 
Effect: The target can move up to their movement speed 
and then pick up a willing or unconscious creature of 
medium size or less, of reasonable weight and size (think 
around 300 pounds or less), that is not encumbered. Until 
they stop carrying this creature, it do es not count towards 
the target’s encumbrance or speed. The target can only 
pick up one creature at a time this way, and it uses at least 
one of their hands.
