I Got a Bad Feeling 
About This 
Warlord Utility 6 
When all else fails, you know to listen to your gut.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Divination 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: You can ask the DM one question about the current 
situation or an action you or the party is about to take. The 
DM can only respond with “You have a good feeling about 
this,” “You have a bad feeling about this,” or “You have 
mixed feelings about this.” If it’s the last answer, the DM 
should at least give some sort of ratio of good to bad 
feelings. 
Special: You may use this power twice before each 
extended rest. 
 
Reading the Gut
 
Answer this power from what the character could 
plausibly sense 
— the tension in a room, the 
wrongness of a too -quiet road — rather than from 
what the party hasn’t discovered yet. A bad 
feeling flags danger, not its source. When the 
answer is mixed, a roug h ratio (“mostly good, but 
something here is off”) gives the party something 
to act on without handing them the plot.
 
 
Lead from the Front 
Warlord Utility 6 
You take your place at the head of the charge, where a 
commander belongs. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Battle Preparation 
No Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You roll initiative for a combat encounter and you 
are not surprised. 
Effect: If you are between all enemies and all of your allies, 
you gain a +2 bonus to your initiative check. On the first 
round of combat, you also gain a +2 bonus to your attack 
rolls, skill checks, and ability checks — as long as you end 
your standard action clo ser to an enemy — until the end of 
your first turn. 
 
Old War Buddy 
(Warlord) 
Warlord Utility 6 
You look around with recognition at this place. “Well I’ll be 
— this 
is where my old campaign comrade settled down. Come on, if I 
know them, they’ll be at the nearest tavern trading war stories,
and they still owe me for pulling them off the line at Kellen
’s Ford. 
If anyone can tell us what’s going on here, it’s them.”
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Social, Gathering 
Information 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Special: The first time you use this power you may 
designate a nearby populated settlement as having a 
contact. Work with the DM to decide the nature of this 
contact. The contact must be related to your past as a 
soldier or commander. Every time you use this power after 
the first time, use the below effect. 
Effect: You are easily able to find the chosen contact if you 
are in the area they frequent, or are easily able to find out 
if they’ve moved on from the area. If they or someone else 
has made it difficult for some reason (for example, they are 
in hiding, were kidn apped, they’re a criminal, or you chose 
someone extremely important and busy, like an old noble 
you swore your allegiance to) you gain a bonus to any 
checks to find hints in the area of their location, well -
being, or to bypass the people or politics to fin d them 
equal to your Wisdom modifier + 2. The contact will only 
help you with information. You gain a +5 bonus to 
knowledge checks for information they would reasonably 
know while talking to them if they are amenable to help. 
Special: You may choose this ability again even if you have 
already learned it to gain additional contacts. You may 
also choose a new contact if an old one dies or becomes 
inaccessible. 
 
Old War Buddy Contacts
 
Contacts a warlord might have left behind: the 
quartermaster who now keeps a general store, the 
sergeant who took over an inn, the scout who 
married into a local family, the field surgeon 
serving as the town healer, or the officer who 
traded a commission f
or a seat on the council. 
Pick someone whose current trade gives them a 
reason to hear things.

New Level 10 Utility Warlord Exploits
 
 
 
A Harsh Lesson in 
Skill Challenges 
Warlord Utility 10 
Losses can be just as important as victories. You teach an ally 
how to harness a loss; as demotivating as it may be in the 
moment, you know it will come in handy in the future.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: Your party fails a skill challenge or a group skill 
check. 
Effect: You gain experience points as if the party had 
succeeded at the skill challenge. You may also choose one 
ally. That ally may choose to lose a healing surge if they 
have any; if they do, they gain 1 action point. 
 
Learning from a Loss
 
A failed skill challenge should still move the story 
— the party reaches the ruins late, or talks their 
way in but owes someone a favor. This power 
rewards the table for playing the failure out rather 
than reloading it, so hand out the experience and 
let the consequence stand. 
 
Cultivated 
Conscience of 
Good 
Warlord Utility 10 
You’ve turned your team not just into good warriors, but good 
people. They all have a keen sense of the consequences of good
and bad actions. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Martial, Social, Divination 
Immediate 
Interrupt 
Personal 
Trigger: You or an ally begins to take an action. 
Target: The triggering creature 
Effect: If the action would negatively affect a PC or an NPC 
ally of the target’s at some point in the future, the target 
gets a feeling in their conscience that it will, and of who it 
will affect. They do not learn why. 
Special: The DM may activate this power without the player 
needing to. 
 
Echoing Guidance 
Warlord Utility 10 
Your words rattle around in the background of an ally’s thought
until they emerge at the right time, usually in the form of a 
flashback or echoing words of wisdom.
 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be taking a short or extended rest. 
Target: One ally resting with you 
Effect: The target gains a d4 guidance die. They may spend 
the guidance die to add it to a skill check they make. They 
keep this die until the end of their next extended rest or 
until it is spent. 
 
 
 
Motivational 
Decompression 
Warlord Utility 10 
You give a motivational speech while everyone rests, to ready 
yourselves for the challenges ahead.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Battle Preparation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You and your allies are taking a short rest. 
Target: You and each ally who can hear you during this 
short rest and who spends a healing surge 
Effect: The target gains temporary hit points equal to 1 + 
your Charisma modifier or Wisdom modifier. These 
temporary hit points last until the end of your next combat 
encounter or until you begin your next short or extended 
rest, whichever comes first. 
 
Perfected Surprise 
Attack Stratagem 
Warlord Utility 10 
After carefully arranging your team, you are able to execute an 
ambush with lethal effectiveness.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Battle Preparation 
No Action 
Personal

New Level 16 Utility Warlord Exploits 
 
 
Back 'Em Up 
Warlord Utility 16 
One of yours comes up short, and before the failure can settle y
already have the right person stepping in behind them.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial 
Immediate 
Reaction 
Personal 
Trigger: An ally fails a skill check. 
Target: One ally who did not trigger this power and who is 
trained in the triggering skill 
Effect: The target makes the same skill check, adding a 
bonus equal to your Charisma, Wisdom, or Intelligence 
modifier. If the target succeeds, the triggering skill check 
does not count as a failure. 
 
 
Battle Retrospective 
Meeting 
Warlord Utility 16 
Before anyone gets comfortable, you walk the party back throu
the fight blow by blow. Next time you meet these things, nobod
will be guessing. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Battle Preparation 
No Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You and your allies are taking a short or extended 
rest after a combat encounter. 
Effect: Choose a number of enemy types from your last 
encounter equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 
of 1). In your next encounter, you and your allies deal an 
extra 1d6 damage with your attacks against enemies of 
those types, which increases by another 1 d6 on a critical 
hit. This extra damage is not added to ongoing damage or 
to flat damage from zones. 
In addition, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to your 
defenses against attacks from those enemies. These effects 
end after your next short or extended rest. 
 
Defensive Spin 
Warlord Utility 16 
Your haft becomes a blur, batting aside anything that comes ne
you or the people at your shoulder 
— and it bites the air hard 
enough to carry you down gently, too.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Stance, Physical 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be wielding a spear, a staff, or a 
polearm. 
Effect: Until the stance ends, you and each ally adjacent to 
you gain a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex. This bonus 
does not apply to an ally who is between you and an 
enemy targeting them. This stance can be sustained for up 
to 1 hour while you are out of combat , instead of 5 
minutes. You cannot use other weapon powers or make 
other weapon attacks while you are in this stance. 
In addition, while you are falling you slowly glide downward 
like a landing helicopter. While falling in this stance, you 
may choose to gain a fly speed of 1, but at the end of each 
of your turns you fall up to 3 squares. 
Special: If you are wielding a reach weapon, extend the 
range of your AC and Reflex bonuses by 1 square. Also, 
you do not take falling damage for a fall of 3 squares or 
less. 
 
 
Delegate Skill 
Warlord Utility 16 
You know the limits of your own training, and you know exactly
who to hand the job to instead.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Social, Physical 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 5 
Target: One ally in the burst who can see or hear you 
Effect: The target gains a +5 bonus to a skill that you are not 
trained in and that you have not attempted since the end 
of your last extended rest. The bonus lasts for the next 
hour or until the end of the next encounter. During that 
time, you take a -5 penalty to that skill. 
 
Efficient Break 
Warlord Utility 16 
You efficiently tell everyone to get a quick breather, direct some
people to patch up others, grab some water, slap them on the 
back, and with a reluctant groan, you all keep moving. There's n
time to stop, not right now.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Martial Practice 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: There are no enemies that you or your allies 
can currently see, and you are not aware of any invisible 
enemies in your immediate vicinity. The combat is 
essentially over, or between waves or phases. 
Cast Time: 30 seconds 
Effect: You and all of your allies who can see or hear you 
and who are not currently in combat may each make a DC 
22 Endurance check. You may then take a short rest. This 
rest lasts 30 seconds instead of 5 minutes. Every ally who 
succeeded on the Endurance check also benefits from this 
short rest. 
You and your allies may not use Rest powers during this 
short rest. You may, however, end any negative effects 
that end at the end of an encounter, keep any positive 
effects that end at the end of an encounter, and spend 
healing surges and gain the other b enefits of a short rest. 
You may also choose to roll a second Endurance check. If 
you roll a 20 or higher, the short rest takes only 10 
seconds — one round of combat time — such as when 
enemies are about to bust down the door and even 30 
seconds is too long. If you roll a 9 or low er, you do not 
benefit from the short rest at all. 
 
I Read Your Book! 
Warlord Utility 16 
You’ve studied this enemy — their campaigns, their doctrine, their
bad habits. You know what they are about to do because they 
have done it before. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Gathering Information, 
War 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: Make an Intelligence ability check, or a Tactics skill 
check if that skill exists in your campaign. Based on the 
result, you may ask a number of questions about an 
enemy, force, or faction. You must already know 
something about the subject, either by havi ng fought them 
before, by researching them, or perhaps by discussing 
them with someone who has known them well. If you are 
learning secondhand by discussing them with someone 
else, or by reading a vague book on the topic, the check 
takes a -2 penalty. The questions must relate either to the 
subject’s current capability or to what they are going to do 
next, and must be able to be intuited, although the DM is 
encouraged to allow wild leaps of logic.

New Level 22 Utility Warlord Exploits 
 
 
Coordinated Home 
Defense 
Warlord Utility 22 
You endlessly think about different ways your home territory ca
be attacked, and have prepared your staff, soldiers, or party to 
execute these pre-planned stratagems. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Stronghold, War 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Effect: All of your PC allies defending your home base or 
stronghold from an outside attack or from internal 
sabotage may spend 1 healing surge and move up to their 
speed. 
Stronghold: If you are using stronghold rules, this can be 
used in the area of any stronghold. If you do, any NPC 
staff, soldiers, or guards who work at or defend the 
stronghold and who can see or hear you immediately gain 
hit points equal to the highest of your Wisd om, 
Intelligence, or Charisma score. 
Warfare: If you are using Warfare rules and are in a Warfare 
encounter, any unit that is in a space with a stronghold or 
home base returns to full casualty health. 
Special: You must spend a week preparing and learning an 
area determined by your DM. Once that time is complete, 
you can declare that area as your home base. 
 
 
Group Practice 
Warlord Utility 22 
While you’re taking a quick break, you have someone 
demonstrate how to get through the next area.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Social, Physical 
No Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You and your allies are taking a short rest. 
Target: Each resting ally who spends a healing surge 
Effect: Choose a skill or ability score, and one of the 
targeted allies to be the demonstrator. Each other targeted 
ally may spend a healing surge. For each one who does, 
the next time they make a skill or ability check using that 
skill or ability, they may use t he demonstrating ally’s 
bonus instead of their own, with an extra bonus equal to 
your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier. This 
effect ends before your next short or extended rest. 
 
Hooooold 
Warlord Utility 22 
You’re used to timing group actions with your volleys, which can
carry on to other coordinated actions, too.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, War, Battle Preparation 
No Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must have a heavy thrown weapon or a 
ranged weapon. 
Trigger: You ready an action or delay your turn. 
Effect: All allies who also ready their action or delay their 
turn to right after the same point in time get a bonus to 
their attacks if you attacked, or a bonus to their skill 
checks and ability checks if you used a skill or ability 
check, equal to your Charisma , Intelligence, or Wisdom 
modifier. If any of these allies critically hit or rolled a 20 
on their skill check or ability check, they and you gain an 
action point. 
Warfare: If you are using Warfare rules and are in a Warfare 
encounter, you may use this power at the end of your turn. 
If you do, until the beginning of your next turn, any 
number of other allies may delay activating one or more of 
their units. For each one who d oes, they may instead 
activate those units at any point during your turn - before, 
after, or between you activating any of your units. They 
gain a +1 bonus to any defenses and defense rolls until the 
beginning of your next turn, and they get a +2 bonus to 
any offensive rolls made during your turn.

Kinetic Coaching 
Warlord Utility 22 
You call the correction out mid-motion — shift the grip, drop the 
hips, drive from the legs — and the body listens before the mind 
catches up. 
Encounter + Non -Combat, Martial, Physical 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You or an ally fails a Strength, Dexterity, or 
Constitution skill check. 
Target: If an ally failed the skill check, this power targets 
you. Otherwise, if you failed the skill check, target an ally. 
Effect: The target may attempt the same skill check with a 
bonus equal to 2 + your Wisdom, Charisma, or 
Intelligence modifier. If they succeed, as a free action you 
may apply this bonus back to the triggering creature if 
they attempt that skill check again this e ncounter. 
 
Retroactive 
Subordinate's Task 
Warlord Utility 22 
In your party’s moment of need, everyone looks to you. Luckily, 
you already anticipated this moment, and have already had you
subordinate do something to adjust for this situation. In the 
distance you hear the horn of reinforcements. Right on time.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Social 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must have an existing NPC ally who was 
already established as friendly with you before your last 
extended rest. You must be out of combat. 
Effect: Choose a point in the past at which your character 
retroactively contacted the friendly NPC ally. It could be to 
contact them for some reason, or to have them contact a 
different creature or faction. Giving them a task does not 
guarantee their success, but it does give them the 
opportunity to have acted at any point before the present 
scene, as if your character had anticipated the current 
situation. 
 
Signal Arrow 
Warlord Utility 22 
The shot goes up, and everyone downrange knows exactly what
means and exactly where to look.
 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Weapon, War 
Standard Action 
Ranged weapon 
Requirement: You must have a ranged weapon or a heavy 
thrown weapon. 
Effect: You may activate another Warlord power you have 
access to and use it as if its origin were anywhere within 
the range of your ranged weapon. That power can’t 
damage or affect enemies, but it can affect allies. Its area 
of effect is doubled, and that power is not expended. 
Warfare: If you are using Warfare rules and are in a Warfare 
encounter, you may apply an ability or square with an 
extra space of range. 
 
Unstoppable Phalanx 
Formation 
Warlord Utility 22 
You lift your shield as an emblem as inspiring as any banner, 
and then charge forward encouraging your unit to do the same
They cannot be stopped. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Stance, War 
Standard Action 
Close burst 60 
Requirement: You must have a shield. 
Target: You and each ally with a shield in the burst who can 
see or hear you, and each ally adjacent to you or to them 
Effect: Until the stance ends, each target gains a +2 bonus 
to their defenses and to their speed, and forced movement 
against them is reduced by 1 square. They cannot be 
slowed, stunned, restrained, or dominated, and they 
increase their charge damage by 1[W]. 
If you attack an enemy, or if you would be stunned, 
restrained, or dominated, the stance ends instead. 
Warfare: If you are using Warfare rules and are in a Warfare 
encounter, you may use this to remove all negative effects 
on your unit, move them 1 space, and give a +2 bonus to 
their defenses until the end of your next turn. 
 
You Can Sleep When 
You're Dead 
Warlord Utility 22 
Nobody is comfortable, nobody is finished, and nobody is going 
argue. Five minutes. Up. 
Daily + Non -Combat, Martial, Rest, Restoration 
No Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You and your allies are taking an extended rest. 
Effect: The extended rest is sped up so that it only takes the 
time of a short rest (5 minutes). You still gain all the 
benefits of an extended rest, except that you do not regain 
this power during this extended rest, and you and your 
allies each regain one less healing surge.

New Level 2 Utility Spells/Hexes
 
 
Fearful Eldritch Speech 
Warlock Utility 2 
You speak words in a tongue never meant for mortal throats. 
Those who hear them without understanding them hear only th
malice underneath. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Fear, Social, Battle 
Preparation 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: You must be able to speak a language other 
than Common. 
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +3 bonus 
to Intimidate checks against creatures that can understand 
a language. You must speak a language to the creature to 
benefit from this bonus, but the creature you are 
intimidating can't speak the language you are speaking 
when using this power. Finally, this power can't boost 
Intimidate checks spoken in Common. 
  
If this power is used out of combat but it triggers 
an initiative check for some reason, on the first round of 
the combat encounter those same creatures get a -2 
penalty to their defenses against powers with the Fear 
keyword. 
 
Forbidden Knowledge 
Ritual 
Warlock Utility 2 
You beseech your patron or one of their servants to teach you 
even more forbidden knowledge, though often it comes at a pri
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual 
Free Action 
Personal 
Special: Upon first gaining this power, choose an Arcana or 
Religion ritual of level 6 or less that you can learn. You 
immediately learn that ritual without having to pay the 
buy cost and can cast it as if you had the Ritual Caster feat 
even if you don't have it. 
Trigger: You are performing the ritual you chose for this 
power. 
Effect: Roll twice for a skill check you are required to make 
for the ritual and choose the higher result. In addition, the 
ritual takes half the time to perform. However, you take 5 
damage if the ritual is successful, +1 damage per level of 
the ritual. 
Elemental Pact: You can also use this power with Primal 
rituals. 
 
 
Minor Desiccation 
Warlock Utility 2 
You draw the moisture out of what you touch, and it crumbles t
dust and dry husk. 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Arcane, Cantrip, Destruction
 
Standard Action 
Melee touch 
Target: One pool or container of water, one non -creature 
plant-life, or (with the Sorcerer-King pact) one creature. 
Effect: • If the target is water or a similar watery liquid that 
is small, like up to 1 quart or liter, it immediately 
evaporates. 
  
• If the target plant -life is medium or smaller, 
including grass, shrubbery, and so on, it withers and dies. 
  
• If the target plant -life is large or bigger, it loses 
some moisture, but it is not enough to fell most trees or 
larger plants without several castings, depending on the 
size. 
Sorcerer-King Pact: If the target is a creature that can get 
thirsty, they get a little thirsty. Or their skin dries a little. If 
you made them thirsty, they will generally be compelled 
to find a drink if they aren't otherwise distracted with 
something important or in combat. Their physical ability 
or skill checks, or your DCs in physical skill challenges 
against them, get a -2 penalty until they get a drink or for 
1 hour. If you targeted their skin, they get a -1 penalty to 
Charisma ability checks or skill checks using their looks to 
influence others for the next 1 hour. 
Elemental Pact: Once you absorb the water from 
something, you can later emit the water from your hands 
or an implement. You can only absorb up to an amount of 
water equal to the amount in a waterskin, or about 2 liters 
or half a gallon or 4 pints.

New Level 6 Utility Spells/Hexes
 
 
Desiccate Plants 
Warlock Utility 6 
You level your rod at the ground and the water answers, dragge
up out of root and soil to spiral once around the implement befo
it thins away into nothing. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Implement, Destruction
 
Standard Action 
Melee touch or Area burst 2 within 1 
square 
Special: When using this as a ranged power, you must be 
using it through an implement you are proficient with. If 
you are, you may increase the range by +1 for every +1 
enhancement bonus on the implement. 
Effect: • All water in the burst or one continuous amount of 
water you are touching immediately evaporates, up to 
about 100 gallons or 10 cubic feet. This includes water, 
watery liquids, and mist. Ice and other frozen watery 
liquids evaporate at half the rate. 
  
• All non -creature plant-life within the burst or 
that you touch that is medium or smaller, including grass, 
shrubbery, and so on, withers and dies. 
  
• Any plant -life within the burst that is large or 
bigger loses some more moisture, but it is not enough to 
fell most trees or larger plants without several castings, 
depending on the size. If you touch a larger plant instead 
of using the area burst, you can make it wither and die if it 
is no larger than the size of your average oak tree. 
Sorcerer-King Pact: You may use this twice before each 
extended rest. The burst also increases by +1 when using 
an implement, and the touch effect can fell even the 
largest of non-magical trees. 
Elemental Pact: You may use this twice before each 
extended rest. You may also use this to emit the water you 
absorb. You can only store up to about 20 of the gallons 
you absorb this way, and you can emit it into an open 
container with your hands or an implement, or make it fall 
from the sky in an 8 -square cube (40 feet). 
 
Ethereal Jump 
Warlock Utility 6 
A minute of muttered syllables and small precise gestures, and 
then, you are simply not there. You are standing a short distanc
away. 
At-Will + Non-Combat, Arcane, Teleportation, Ritual, 
Exploration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 1 minute. 
Effect: You teleport 3 squares. 
Dark Pact: Can teleport +1 square if your destination 
square is heavily obscured by darkness or shadow. 
Infernal Pact: Can teleport +1 square if your destination 
square has a majority of fire or ice in it. 
Elemental Pact: Can teleport +2 squares if your destination 
square has a majority of an element associated with your 
current elemental affinity. 
Fey Pact: The cast time is reduced to 30 seconds. 
 
 
Glamor Disguise 
Warlock Utility 6 
You conjure fey magic to change your appearance.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Illusion, Deception 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Target: One creature you can see that is only up to one size 
larger or smaller than you. 
Effect: You adopt the target's appearance until the end of 
your next turn. You gain a +5 bonus to Bluff checks 
related to mimicking the target. Your apparent size and 
equipment matches the creature, but you gain neither the 
abilities, mannerisms, or tactile or aud itory properties of 
them. If anyone touches your real self through the illusion 
(or fails to touch your real self if you are disguised as 
someone larger than you are, for example), they will 
realize you are not as you seem. 
Sustain Minor: You sustain the effects until the end of your 
next turn. This can be sustained up to 6 hours this way. 
Fey Pact: If used out of combat, this effect lasts for up to 10 
minutes before you start needing to sustain it. You may 
also sustain it up to 24 hours instead of 6. 
 
Knowledge from Beyond 
Warlock Utility 6 
You channel or consult otherworldly entities to gain increased 
knowledge. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Divination, 
Gathering Information 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: Take 10 damage or lose a healing surge. 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You gain a +5 bonus to a knowledge or monster 
knowledge check related to Arcana, Dungeoneering, 
History, Nature, or Streetwise, or an ally gets a +3 bonus 
to such a skill check. You or the ally must be trained in 
that skill to receive the bonus. 
Vestige Pact or Star Pact: You can use this power to boost 
a skill you don't have trained, but you take an additional 5 
damage in addition to whatever cost you paid for this 
ritual power. 
 
Lesser Dark One's Luck 
Warlock Utility 6 
You conjure a delicate charm that distorts luck and warps fate, 
but only when you are not pressured by the stress of a violent 
encounter. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane 
Free Action 
Personal 
Requirement: This cannot be used during a combat 
encounter. 
Trigger: You make a skill check or ability check roll you 
dislike. 
Effect: Reroll the skill check or ability check, using the 
higher of the two results.

113 
 
 
Magic Circle the Focused 
Warlock Utility 6 
You draw a circle that glows and sparks, keeping the dangerous
creature at bay for now. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Binding 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Special: When you gain this power, choose one from the 
following list of creature origins: aberrant, elemental, fey, 
immortal, or shadow. This choice is permanent, but you 
can change this choice on level up. 
Cost: 100 gp 
Cast Time: 30 minutes. 
Effect: This power is identical to the Magic Circle ritual, but 
can only be used against creatures of the origin you chose. 
  
You inscribe a circle on the ground that requires 1 
minute to draw per square inside the circle (and it must be 
a circle). You then perform the ritual by making an Arcana 
check. 
  
An affected creature whose level is lower than 
your Arcana check result minus 10 cannot pass through 
the circle, affect creatures through the circle's boundary, 
or affect the boundary in any way. Other creatures of an 
affected origin take force damage equa l to your Arcana 
check result when passing through the boundary, but 
doing so breaks the circle. Unaffected creatures can take a 
standard action to obscure the inscription and break the 
circle. 
 
Summon Eldritch Steed 
Warlock Utility 6 
The shadows coalesce into something that is almost a horse, 
which steps out of the darkness to carry you.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Conjuration, Ritual, Travel, 
Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You conjure a Large horselike Beast creature that can 
be ridden by you. It has a speed of 10. The steed cannot 
attack or affect other creatures in any way other than to 
serve as a mount. Its defense scores are equal to yours, 
although it only has 1 hit poi nt. It lasts until dismissed or 
for 8 hours. 
Dark Pact: The mount gains the Shadow type, immune to 
all effects except damage. 
Infernal Pact: The mount gains the Immortal (devil) type, it 
gains health equal to your bloodied hit points, and 
resistance 10 to fire damage. 
Fey Pact: The mount gains the Fey type. As an encounter 
power move action, it can teleport up to 5 squares. 
Elemental Pact: It gains the elemental and magical beast 
types (aquatic, water). It can run on water as fast as it can 
run on land. 
Vestige Pact: You may increase the cast time to 1 hour and 
spend 200 gp in components or use 1 healing surge when 
using this power to use any one of the pact bonuses from 
above. 
 
 
The Logic of Madness 
Warlock Utility 6 
Secondary effects from your patron seep into your mind, causin
a type of magic. Sometimes it causes trouble, other times it cau
amazing leaps of logic that don't make sense, but lead to result
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Social, Gathering 
Information 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You are making a Diplomacy or Bluff check to 
convince someone of something, an Insight check to learn 
something about someone, a Perception or similar check 
to investigate something, or are making a skill check to 
gather information. 
Effect: Roll a d20. On a 1 -10, you get a -5 penalty to the 
triggering check. On an 11 -20, you get a +5 bonus to the 
triggering check. 
  
If you fail the check, you may confuse or anger the 
recipient, causing -2 penalties to further checks of the 
same category this encounter. If you succeed on the check, 
the DM may choose to grant you one pertinent piece of 
information related to the check, something your 
character probably shouldn't have known but they seem 
to know anyway.

New Level 10 Utility Spells/Hexes
 
 
Desiccate Creatures 
Warlock Utility 10 
You turn the same working on living things, and what answers 
the rod is the water inside them.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Implement, Destruction
 
Standard Action 
Melee touch or Area burst 3 within 1 
square 
Special: When using this as a ranged power, you must be 
using it through an implement you are proficient with. If 
you are, you may increase the range by +1 for every +1 
enhancement bonus on the implement. 
Effect: All non -construct, non-undead creatures in the area 
other than you, or being touched by you, have moisture 
drawn from their bodies. 
  
Make a Constitution or Charisma (whichever is 
higher) vs. Fortitude attack against each creature in the 
area. Each creature you hit suffers 5 damage every 1 hour 
until they drink something that satiates thirst. Plant 
creatures, water elementals, and other water-based 
creatures take 10 damage every 30 minutes instead. 
  
Affected creatures can ignore the effects of this 
power for 1 hour by making a DC 15 Endurance check. 
However, every time they succeed on this check, the DC 
increases by +5 until the effect ends or until they fail the 
check. 
Sorcerer-King Pact: You may use this twice before each 
extended rest. The burst also increases by +1 when using 
an implement, and the touch effect doubles the damage 
and halves the interval once more. 
Elemental Pact: You may use this twice before each 
extended rest. If you reduce the hit points of a water 
elemental to 0 this way, you may summon a Lesser Water 
Elemental (MV) with this. 
 
Devil's Granted Wings 
Warlock Utility 10 
You grow wings for a long period of time, allowing prolonged 
flight, although they get in the way and require full concentratio
preventing fighting while using them.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Polymorph, Ritual, Travel
 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 30 seconds. 
Effect: You grow wings for as long as you concentrate on 
sustaining this power with your standard action, up to 8 
hours. During this time, you gain the ability to fly with an 
overland speed of 10 and a fly speed of 5, and you gain a 
+2 bonus to Intimidate checks. As soon as you start to fly, 
you cannot take any other actions during that flight except 
to move or land. Once you land after taking flight, the 
wings disappear. If the effect ends while you are in the air, 
you slowly glide to the ground without taking dam age. 
 
 
Elemental Cloak of 
Protection 
Warlock Utility 10 
With great focus, you surround an ally with a magical cloak tha
allows them to dive into the pool of acid or walk past the wall of
fire unharmed. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Warding 
Standard Action 
Ranged 5 
Prerequisite: Elemental Pact or Infernal Pact. 
Cast Time: 1 minute. 
Target: One ally 
Effect: You give an ally immunity to elemental damage until 
the beginning of their next turn. If you have the Infernal 
Pact, they are immune to fire damage. If you have the 
Elemental Pact, they are immune to whatever your 
current elemental affinity is. 
Sustain Standard: The target ally is immune to the chosen 
damage until the beginning of their next turn. You can 
sustain this power up to 15 minutes. 
 
Magic Circle Against the 
Natural 
Warlock Utility 10 
You draw a circle that glows and sparks, keeping even mundane
dangerous creatures at bay. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Binding 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 100 gp 
Cast Time: 30 minutes. 
Effect: This power is identical to the Magic Circle ritual, but 
can only be used against creatures of the natural origin. 
  
You inscribe a circle on the ground that requires 1 
minute to draw per square inside the circle (and it must be 
a circle). You then perform the ritual by making an Arcana 
check. 
  
An affected creature whose level is lower than 
your Arcana check result minus 10 cannot pass through 
the circle, affect creatures through the circle's boundary, 
or affect the boundary in any way. Other creatures of an 
affected origin take force damage equa l to your Arcana 
check result when passing through the boundary, but 
doing so breaks the circle. Unaffected creatures can take a 
standard action to obscure the inscription and break the 
circle. 
 
Missing Time 
Warlock Utility 10 
They will remember the hour before, and the moment after, and
nothing of the space between.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Deception 
Standard Action 
Melee touch 
Requirement: You are out of combat. 
Target: One creature you touch that is not involved in 
combat 
Effect: You remove from 1 to 10 minutes of the target's 
memory from within their last hour. You cannot read their 
mind, so you must either pick a time frame (the last few 
minutes, for example) or a specific memory you know 
exists (that they met you, that they met an ally of yours, or 
that they saw someone sneaking). If the creature enters 
combat, they regain their memories.

Remote Fey Switch 
Warlock Utility 10 
You place a benevolent form of your curse on an ally, binding th
two of you across any distance.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Teleportation, Ritual, 
Travel 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Target: One ally 
Effect: You place a benevolent form of your curse on an ally. 
This has no negative effects and lasts up to 8 hours. At any 
point while this is on them, you or the ally may switch 
places. There is a brief shimmering light during this time 
and it takes about 6 -10 se conds, or about 1-2 rounds, for 
the switch to happen, preventing it from catching anyone 
off-guard if it happens in front of them, but generally being 
a brief moment when it happens out of view. 
  
If it happens during a battle or it triggers a battle, 
and you are out of view of each other, the person who 
enters is surprised for one round. 
  
Level 21: You can increase the cast time to 1 hour 
to increase the duration by up to 24 hours. 
 
Ritual of Chromatic 
Empowerment 
Warlock Utility 10 
You take the element out of the place it collected in and put it in
yourself. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Rest, Battle 
Preparation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Prerequisite: Elemental Pact and you have the Chromatic 
Bolt power. 
Requirement: You must be near a natural or near -natural 
formation of your element. The DM has the final say. It 
should come from the environment, but it is up to the DM. 
This must be done during a rest, but before you know 
what element you'll roll for on the elemental attunement 
table (see Warlock Elemental Pact). 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You perform a ritual to absorb the natural powers of 
the nearby element. Until the end of your next extended 
rest or you use this power again, you empower one of the 
elements. As long as you are attuned to it, you gain one of 
the following effects: 
  
• Acid - When you hit with your Chromatic Bolt, 
until the end of your next turn, lower the AC of one of the 
creatures hit by your Chromatic Bolt by the lower of your 
Charisma or Constitution modifier minus 2. 
  
• Cold - When you hit with your Chromatic Bolt, 
you may gain temporary hit points equal to the lower of 
your Charisma or Constitution modifier until the 
beginning of your next turn. 
  
• Fire - Your Chromatic Bolt deals an extra 1d6 
fire damage to the first target. 
  
• Lightning - You may have your Chromatic Bolt 
deal an additional 2 damage to the first target, 1 damage 
to the second target, and damage equal to the lower of 
your Charisma or Constitution modifier to a third creature 
within 5 squares of your second targe t. If there is no other 
creature within 5 squares, it may deal that damage back to 
the first creature. 
  
• Thunder - You may push the first and second 
target of your Chromatic Bolt away from each other when 
it hits, up to a number of squares equal to the lower of 
your Charisma or Constitution modifier. 
 
EXAMPLES OF NATURAL 
ELEMENTAL FORMATIONS
 
Acid: a pool of acid from a laboratory experiment, an 
acidic swamp, a longstanding acidic trap or hazard, a 
slime’s lair, a caustic geyser, collected acid in bottles, 
acid rain. 
Cold: a field of ice or snow, a near
-frozen lake, a 
blizzard, snowfall, hail. 
Fire: a large fire (wild or long -burning), lit lanterns, 
lava, a magma geyser, a large forge. 
Lightning: a lightning storm, rain, a laboratory with 
electricity, proximity to lots of metal or arcane 
machinery, “pre-storm” static in the air, carpets or 
rugs with static cling, magnetic phenomena. 
Thunder: a lightning or wind storm, high wind, a 
hurricane, rain, areas of extreme noise such as 
industrial work sites, echoing canyons or caves. 
 
 
Sacrificial Ritual of 
Reclamation 
Warlock Utility 10 
A life given freely, or given unwillingly, buys back a working you
thought was spent. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: One willing or helpless creature, sacrificed. 
Cast Time: 1 hour. 
Effect: Roll an Arcana or Religion check, depending on 
whether the target ritual power will be Arcane or Divine 
respectively. It has a DC equal to 35 - the level of the 
sacrificed creature. If you succeed on the check, you or an 
ally within 5 squares regains one e xpended ritual power 
that is at least half that level or below (rounded down) and 
uses the associated power source. This cannot be used on 
creatures above level 30. 
 
Shadowy Touch 
Warlock Utility 10 
Your hand becomes of shadows and misty wisps, passing throug
the physical easily while still imparting the magical effects you'v
infused into your touch. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Deception 
Minor Action 
Personal or Melee touch 
Target: You or one creature you touch 
Effect: When used out of combat, as long as the target is 
even slightly distracted or looking away, your next Touch 
power can be used without its target and others in the 
vicinity aware you have used it on them. If they are a bit 
more aware of your presence, the D M may determine you 
need to use a Thievery check with an easy DC equal to the 
level of the creature you're trying to use the touch power 
on. If so, it gets a +5 bonus. 
  
When used in combat, you must be hidden and 
actively hiding from the enemy for this power to work on 
them. It also doesn't get any +5 bonus when the DM 
determines you need to use a Thievery check to activate 
this power.

Speaking in Tongues 
Warlock Utility 10 
The words of one tongue are taken out of a mouth and the wor
of another are put in their place.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Social 
Standard Action 
Personal or Melee touch 
Target: You or one creature you touch 
Effect: You or a creature you touch lose the ability to speak 
Common, or a language of your choice if they don't speak 
Common, but they gain the ability to speak and 
understand a language of your choice. The target can still 
understand the native language they los t during this time, 
they just can't speak it or write in it. It lasts 1 hour or until 
you dismiss the effect. 
  
If used on an unwilling creature, you must hit on 
an unarmed melee Constitution or Charisma vs. Will 
attack. 
 
 
Summon Eldritch Hound 
Warlock Utility 10 
You conjure a hound that is only shaped like a hound, and it 
takes the scent you give it.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Conjuration, Ritual, 
Exploration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You conjure a Small or Medium doglike creature to 
help you track other people or things. As long as you have 
a sample of the scent to give the creature, it can detect the 
direction of the creature it's tracking as long as it's within 
1000 feet. It also get s a +5 bonus to Perception, Survival, 
or Nature checks to track the creature, or to aid others in 
tracking. It lasts up to 1 hour. 
  
The conjured creature has 1 hit point and a speed 
of 7, although that is reduced to 3 when tracking. 
Fey Pact: The fey hounds of the hunt are legendary for 
finding their prey. The conjured creature has the fey type 
and it can detect creatures with no limit, even in other 
planes, if it has the scent. They last half the time, though. 
Infernal Pact: The conjured creature has the Immortal 
(demon) or (devil) type and is immune to fire damage but 
has vulnerability 10 to radiant and cold damage. In 
addition, this hell -hound will attempt to protect you. It has 
max hit points equal to yours and two attacks. 
  
Melee Attack. Constitution vs. AC. 1d6 + 
Constitution modifier damage + 1d6 fire damage. 
  
Fire Defense (encounter). Immediate Reaction 
when attacked by a melee attack. Close Burst 1, target 
enemies. Constitution vs. Reflex. On hit: 2d8 + 
Constitution modifier fire damage. 
Dark Pact: The conjured dog has the shadow type. It can 
scout ahead and track for you stealthily before coming 
back to let you know the way. As long as it is in darkness 
or low-light, it can turn invisible as an at -will minor action. 
It has a Stealth check equal to y ours +2. It disappears even 
if a radiant attack misses it, though. 
Elemental Pact: It lasts twice as long if summoned in terrain 
related to your current elemental attunement, gains 
immunity to that element, and gains the elemental type 
and another type related to that element. It is not affected 
by penalties related to your current eleme ntal 
attunement: passing through water or similar liquids will 
not penalize its tracking if it is acid or cold type, fire means 
it's not stopped by strong smells by things like smoke, and 
wind blowing away the scent does not stop it if it is 
lightning or thunder. If the tracked object or creature 
passes through terrain or a situation related to your 
elemental attunement, the hound will alert you. If you 
have the lightning or thunder attunement, the tracking 
range doubles. 
Star Pact: The creature is strange and unnerving, slipping 
through the mind and causing small bouts of madness and 
small twists of fate. Onlookers' eyes will slide right off it. 
Unless the creature brings attention to itself, you can roll 
Stealth vs. Insight to have people you are interacting with 
not notice the hound. 
Vestige Pact: You may increase the cast time to 1 hour and 
spend 400 gp in components or use 2 healing surges 
when using this power to use any one of the pact bonuses 
from above.

through the mind and causing small bouts of madness and
small twists of fate. Onlookers' eyes will slide right off it.
Unless the creature brings attention to itself, you can roll
Stealth vs. Insight to have people you are interacting with
not notice the hound.
Vestige Pact: You may increase the cast time to 1 hour and
spend 400 gp in components or use 2 healing surges
when using this power to use any one of the pact bonuses
from above.

Tentacle From the Other 
Side 
Warlock Utility 10 
You create a portal just large enough for a tentacle to poke 
through and start causing havoc. Whether it's to guard a door, 
cause a distraction, or simply to retrieve something for you, the
tentacle obeys. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Conjuration, Ritual, 
Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 1 round, 1 minute, 10 minutes, or 1 hour. 
Duration: 1 round, 10 minutes, 1 hour, or 6 hours, 
respectively. 
Effect: You make a tentacle sprout from the ground or a 
wall. It has a range of 4 squares. In addition to preventing 
access to that square by taking up space (so if put on the 
ground, no one can step in that square for example), it will 
also attempt to grapple nea rby creatures, hurt them, and 
then drag them into the portal with it. Creatures who are 
dragged into the portal will not be in play until the effect 
ends. This ritual automatically ends if the tentacle dies. It 
has an amount of health equal to your hit poi nts + 10. 
  
You can also command the tentacle to grab 
specific enemies or objects for you, interact with the 
environment, and so on. It will usually expect a reward for 
that. 
  
Standard Melee Attack: Melee 4; Constitution or 
Charisma vs. Reflex. On hit: 2d8 + Constitution or 
Charisma modifier damage and the target is grabbed. 
  
Swing Attack (Standard): Close Burst 2; 
Constitution or Charisma vs. Reflex. On hit: 2d8 + 
Constitution or Charisma modifier damage. 
  
Immediate Reaction: If bloodied or critically hit, it 
will retreat into its portal, becoming untargetable and 
invisible. If it does this, it will let go of any creature it's 
grabbing. The portal will re -open, and the tentacle will re -
emerge at the beginnin g of its next turn. 
Sustain Standard: The tentacle will sustain the grab on a 
grabbed target, deal 1d8 damage to them, and pull them 
1 square closer to it. If they reach the tentacle's square, 
the enemy will disappear until this effect ends. 
Instinctive Effect: If you haven't given the tentacle any 
commands by the end of your turn, it attacks the last 
creature to attack it. Otherwise, it attacks the nearest 
creature it can attack and attempts to grab. If it can't do 
that, it will destroy nearby objects or do a Sw ing Attack, 
keeping enemies afraid to get close. 
Special: If you cast the 1 round version of this ritual power, 
you can think of it as lasting 6 seconds or enough for one 
action. In combat, you must use your whole turn to cast it, 
and you must keep casting it until the beginning of your 
next turn. It then lasts from the beginning of that turn until 
the beginning of your next turn. If used in this way, you 
may take 3 damage to regain this power. 
 
 
Vestige Memory 
Warlock Utility 10 
Something that has already read every book in a dead language
lends you the trick of it. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Social, Gathering 
Information 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 10 minutes. 
Effect: Choose a language. You are able to read and write in 
the chosen language for the next 1 hour. You are also able 
to speak in and understand the language fluently. 
Vestige Pact: The duration extends to 24 hours and you are 
able to store any text you read in the chosen language 
during this time into your vestige's memory, allowing 
perfect recall, search, and analysis of it later. You are also 
able to allow deeper understanding of i t by equipping a 
vestige that understands it better. For the next 1 hour, you 
are able to answer up to 3 questions others ask you about 
the text as if you were a native person from that culture, 
even if it's from long ago. Gain a +5 bonus to History and 
related skill checks related to the writing when answering 
questions others ask you about it during this time, for the 
first 3 questions you are asked at least.

New Level 16 Utility Spells/Hexes
 
 
Billowing Darkness 
Warlock Utility 16 
You create a smoky darkness that fills up the current space you 
are in. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Zone, Deception 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must be indoors. 
Effect: You create a zone of darkness that fills up the current 
room, or closest thing to a room, you are in. It's magical 
darkness that smothers all sources of light that are 
mundane or from a magical item with a level lower than 
you (including items that don't h ave a level, such as sun 
rods). It stops at the edge of doors and similar dividers, 
even if they are open. You gain darkvision while in this 
zone. 
 
 
Curse Item 
Warlock Utility 16 
You infuse an item with dark energy, condemning whoever is 
holding it to the dangers of your magic.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Binding, Battle 
Preparation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 1 minute. 
Effect: You place a version of your curse on an object. It 
lasts until you dismiss it as a minor action, place it on a 
different object, or enter a combat with someone holding 
it and place your warlock's curse on them. Those 
attempting to detect this energy from t he item get a +2 
bonus to their Arcana check. Other than that, you have no 
bonuses to tracking the object, although you are aware if it 
still exists and is whole or broken or destroyed. 
  
Whoever is holding, wielding, or carrying the 
object is afflicted by your curse, although they are not 
aware if it's solely through the item. If a combat encounter 
begins with them, they are afflicted by your item curse as 
long as they are holding it when initiative is rolled. This is 
the same as your normal curse in all ways, except that 1) it 
only gives +1d6 damage, and 2) it stacks with your normal 
curse (allowing it to increase the damage die of your curse 
by an additional 1d6 this way). 
  
Whoever is holding the item is also aware of some 
negative vibes, although they may not be sure why. You 
get a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks against them. The 
curse can be removed by anything that removes curses 
and some other purification effects. 
 
 
Dark Hole Ritual 
Warlock Utility 16 
You draw a circle on the ground, and it opens into somewhere 
else. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 500 gp 
Cast Time: 1 minute to 8 hours. 
Effect: You draw a circle on the ground, conjuring magic 
that turns it into a deep, dark hole of blackness. Objects 
placed inside of it disappear after being more than about a 
foot from the surface, but you can still feel them to bring 
them out. It is at minimum 1 foot wide and 1 foot deep. 
Any larger requires increased cast time and an Arcana 
check. The hole is permanent until you use this ritual 
power somewhere else or dismiss it. It will move any 
creatures or objects in the hole to the new location once 
this is used again while a hole still exists. It can't be 
dismissed while objects or creatures are still in it.

King's Command 
Warlock Utility 16 
You infuse your words with power, and it crushes any doubt or 
refusal from their mind. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Charm, Social 
Standard Action 
Melee Touch 
Effect: You give a command to a creature that can hear you 
and that you are touching. If the creature is hostile or 
otherwise tries to avoid being touched, you must first 
succeed on a Charisma vs. Will attack to use the rest of 
this power. 
  
Make a Diplomacy or Intimidate check with a +5 
power bonus, with a DC equal to that creature's Will. If 
you succeed, they must follow the command, even if they 
normally wouldn't. Self-preservation, their own attitude or 
reasonableness or previous thoughts or personality won't 
stop them from fulfilling it. However, they will attempt a 
saving throw to escape if it threatens their self -
preservation. 
  
They will follow it for the next 10 minutes or until 
they fulfill it. If the action was reasonable, they will 
probably think they did it. If it is not, they may realize 
what happened. It ends automatically if they take damage. 
Sorcerer-King Pact: A one-word command gets a +10 
bonus. Also, either way, it lasts up to 1 hour or until they 
fulfill the command. 
Fey Pact: If they attempt a saving throw, instead you may 
roll a Diplomacy or Intimidate check vs. their Will again 
and use that as the result.

pages.rawText:
123 
 
Lesser Eye of the Warlock 
Warlock Utility 16 
A smaller third eye opens, and you borrow another creature's 
senses. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Scrying 
Standard Action 
Ranged 20 or Melee Touch 
Target: One creature 
Effect: You see through the target's eyes, hear through their 
ears, and smell through their nose. The target is not aware 
that you are doing so. You do not have line of sight and 
line of effect from the target for your attacks. During this 
time, you lose perception of your own senses. This lasts for 
up to 5 minutes or until you end the connection. 
  
If this is used from melee touch range, the effect 
lasts up to 24 hours or until you dismiss it, and you do not 
lose your senses immediately. Instead, you keep them, and 
during the duration of the effect you can switch between 
your own perceptions and the target's at will as a minor 
action. 
 
Magic Circle Against All 
Warlock Utility 16 
You draw a circle that glows and sparks, keeping even mundane
dangerous creatures at bay. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Binding 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 200 gp 
Cast Time: 1 hour. 
Effect: This power is identical to the Magic Circle ritual, but 
can only be used against all creatures, regardless of type or 
origin. 
  
You inscribe a circle on the ground that requires 1 
minute to draw per square inside the circle (and it must be 
a circle). You then perform the ritual by making an Arcana 
check. 
  
An affected creature whose level is lower than 
your Arcana check result minus 10 cannot pass through 
the circle, affect creatures through the circle's boundary, 
or affect the boundary in any way. Other creatures of an 
affected origin take force damage equa l to your Arcana 
check result when passing through the boundary, but 
doing so breaks the circle. Unaffected creatures can take a 
standard action to obscure the inscription and break the 
circle. 
 
Recouping Arcane 
Backlash 
Warlock Utility 16 
Magic does not come back for free. You take the cost out of 
yourself. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Restoration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 1 minute. 
Effect: You regain one encounter or daily Arcane Non -
Combat power of level 16 or lower. You take 5 damage if 
the level of the power is 6 or lower, 10 damage if the level 
is 10 or lower, and 20 damage if the level of it is higher 
than 10. This damage bypasses tempo rary hit points. 
Dark Pact: A willing ally within 1 square of you may choose 
to take the damage, plus an additional 5 damage, instead.

Warlock Utility 16

count. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Restoration 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You must have a bladed or piercing weapon 
in hand.

Target: One willing or helpless allied PC or an allied 
creature you care about 
Effect: Kill the target. Choose one of the following effects: 
  
• The next ritual you are performing or 
participating in before your next extended rest is now free 
to cast and takes half the time. 
  
• You or an ally regains an expended daily Non -
Combat power. 
  
• You and all allies gain 1 healing surge and heal 
a number of hit points equal to your surge value. 
  
• You and all allies with 0 action points gain 1 
action point. 
 
 
Shade Door Shortcut 
Warlock Utility 16 
The Shadowfell is closer than it looks, and it will lend you a 
hallway. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Teleportation, Ritual, 
Travel 
Standard Action 
Ranged 5 
Cost: 100 gp 
Cast Time: 1 hour. 
Effect: This ritual power can be used twice before it is 
expended. The first time it is used you create a shadowy 
door. It's about the size of a normal door. It cannot be 
opened until you create a second door. The next time you 
use this power, you create another s hadowy door. 
Creatures can instantly travel between them by using a 
minor action to open the door and a move action to step 
through. It counts as a teleport, but the user does not have 
to see the other side. 
  
Once a door has been created, it lasts forever until 
dismissed, or destroyed in some way. Dismissing a shade 
door takes a 1 minute ritual if you are within 5 squares of 
it, otherwise it takes a 1 hour ritual. As long as a shade 
door is created from this po wer and still exists, you cannot 
regain this power. You must dismiss one or both of your 
old portals in order to regain this power. 
Dark Pact: You and allied creatures exit the shade doors 
with a +5 bonus to Stealth checks until the end of their 
next turn. It is also hard to see the doors if they are in 
darkness or low -light. A DC 20 Perception check is 
required, and it is invisible in darkness ( even to creatures 
with darkvision). 
Fey Pact: Whenever you or an allied creature teleports with 
this power, you may have them appear in a random 
square within 3 squares of the exit, instead of in that 
square. 
Infernal Pact: Whenever an enemy creature uses your 
shade doors, they take 1d6 fire damage upon exiting. 
Star Pact: They see maddening visions. Creatures are dazed 
upon exiting for one turn. 
 
 
Summon Infernal Advisor 
Warlock Utility 16 
Through painstaking research and preparation, you prepare a 
valuable offering for a powerful, knowledgeable being, such as 
demigod, demon, devil, or fae. Your offering earns you an 
audience with the being, which appears in a magic circle, 
unfriendly, but may be willing to help with the right words.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Binding, Gathering 
Information, Social 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 10,000 gp 
Cast Time: 8 hours. 
Effect: You draw a magic circle and summon a powerful 
extraplanar entity in it that can offer you information. 
While in the circle, no one outside the circle has line of 
effect to it and it does not have line of effect to you. 
  
You must succeed on a skill challenge to obtain 
the information you desire from that entity. This challenge 
might be against Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate, 
depending on the creature. The complexity of the 
challenge and the difficulty of the DCs are up to the 
creature you are summoning and the difficulty of the 
information you are trying to obtain, but they are generally 
Complexity 3 and medium DC. 
  
The offering may help move a creature that is in 
an evil or hostile state into a more neutral state, willing to 
hear you out. But one would be wise to remember that all 
such entities have agendas of their own, and their nature 
might color the information a nd advice they provide. If 
you can successfully convince them, they will try to be 
helpful to you, but it will be in their own way. 
  
When you complete the ritual power, you can 
designate up to eight other participants who can also 
speak with the entity and contribute to the skill challenge. 
 
We're All Mad Down Here 
Warlock Utility 16 
While others think you mad, you've only gained knowledge 
beyond their understanding, allowing you to perceive the logic o
things without logic, and the sense in things without sense.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Social 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Effect: You are able to speak to animals for the next 1 hour 
or until you dismiss this power. You get a +2 bonus to 
Diplomacy and Nature checks with them. 
Infernal Pact: You are able to speak Supernal. When you 
speak this language, you get a +5 bonus when speaking to 
angels, demons, devils, and other immortals that speak it 
as a native language and a +5 bonus to understanding 
their strange world through knowledge checks. 
Fey Pact: You are able to speak Elven. When you speak this 
language, you get a +5 bonus when speaking to fey, elves, 
and beasts, and you are able to use this language to speak 
to constructs and animate creatures, even ones that 
normally do not speak any language. If in the Feywild, you 
can even speak to plants and objects. 
Dark Pact: You are able to speak Elven. When you speak 
this language, you get a +5 bonus when speaking to fey, 
elves, and certain beasts (spiders, bats, bugs, and snakes). 
If in the Shadowfell, you are able to speak to undead, 
ghosts, and other such creatures, even ones who are 
animate or normally do not speak a language. 
Elemental Pact: You are able to speak Primordial. When 
you speak this language, you gain a +5 bonus when 
speaking to elementals, archons, and efreets, even ones 
that normally do not speak any language.

New Level 22 Utility Spells/Hexes
 
 
Bottomless Hole 
Warlock Utility 22 
You can create a portal to endless blackness, a portable hole wi
no end. Where it leads to is a mystery, and you definitely can't 
retrieve people or items from such a hole. But sometimes you ne
a bottomless pit. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 50 gp per 1 ft diameter 
Cast Time: 8 hours. 
Effect: You draw a circle on the ground, conjuring magic 
that turns it into a deep, dark hole of blackness, similar to 
the Dark Hole Ritual, but this one seemingly has no end. 
Objects placed inside of it disappear after being more than 
about a foot from the surface, and seem to keep falling 
forever. It is at minimum 1 foot wide, and a max of 20 feet 
wide. 
  
A successful Arcana check with a DC of 40 is 
required to use this power. If you fail, you can transition 
into making this a Dark Hole Ritual if you have that ritual 
or ritual power (Warlock 16), using the result of that 
Arcana check as the result for that effect. 
  
This hole is permanent until you use this ritual 
power somewhere else or dismiss it. It can be dismissed 
while objects or creatures are still in it. 
Dark Pact: You can make a temporary version with less 
time. The cast time becomes 20 minutes, but it only lasts 
1 hour afterwards. The cost increases to 100 gp per 1 ft. 
The size is from 1 ft up to 5 ft diameter. 
Fey Pact: You are able to redirect the hole to fall into a 
portion of the Feywild as a minor action. When used this 
way, anything put in the pit since it was last created or 
dismissed is redirected to the Feywild as well. You can 
jump into the hole to go there, use it to store stuff in a 
glade there, etc. As a minor action, you can change it back 
to a bottomless pit. 
Elemental Pact: You are able to connect the hole into one 
of the Elemental Planes of Chaos as a minor action, and 
back. When used this way, it becomes a vertical stream of 
chaotic elemental magic energy. As a standard action, or 
also sometimes at random if the DM decides it, the pit 
shoots out from 100 feet (20 squares) to 1,000 feet (200 
squares), a burst of energy that deals damage of the same 
type as your current elemental affinity. It deals 3d10 
damage per 5 feet of diameter of the hole to any creature 
caught in the geyser during this blast. 
 
 
Curse of Madness 
Warlock Utility 22 
Your hand begins to glow and a symbol appears on it. "No, 
please. Not my mind. Anything but that!" They beg, but to no 
avail. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Psychic, Binding 
Standard Action 
Melee Touch 
Target: One sentient creature. Cannot be animated or a 
construct. 
Attack: Make a Charisma or Constitution attack vs. Will. If 
the creature is at all aware of this happening or is in 
combat, they get a +5 bonus to their Will defense and you 
get a -5 penalty to your attack. 
Hit: The creature begins to get affected by a type of insanity. 
They are prone to babbling and mumbling, or spouting 
incoherent sentences at inopportune times. They are also 
harder to have a straightforward conversation or use logic 
with. They get a -2 penalty to Diplomacy, Bluff, Insight, 
and other social checks, and other people's attempts to 
use such checks to sway them get a -2 penalty. They make 
a saving throw to end the effect at the end of every 
extended rest, and it works like a disease track. Successful 
saving throws bring them closer to sane, failed saving 
throws make them more insane. There is no max duration. 
  
After the first failed saving throw, they begin to 
lose some memories. Whenever they attempt to recall 
something important, they must make a saving throw. If 
they fail, they do not remember. They also get a -5 penalty 
to Intelligence and Knowledge checks. 
  
After the second failed saving throw, they lose all 
memories of their previous self and begin to adopt a new 
personality or new memories that aren't real. They will 
begin to wander to random places, see random visions or 
just random sounds, and may think t hey're someone 
they're not. 
  
After the third failed saving throw, the effect 
becomes much more permanent. They make the save to 
end after every month instead of every extended rest and 
the saving throw gets a -2 penalty. After one year, the 
effect is permanent. 
Star Pact: You are able to imbue this curse into runes or 
words that trigger when read. Once triggered, the curse is 
removed from the item. You also get a +2 bonus to try to 
get information from them instead of a -2 penalty. 
Fey Pact: You get a +2 bonus to sway them, instead of a -2 
penalty. 
Dark Pact or Infernal Pact: The target becomes violently 
mad. They are more likely to attack people who get too 
close once they've lost their memories, rather than just 
wander or mumble. 
Vestige Pact: You send vestiges to haunt them. They get a -
1 penalty to their saving throws on this power. 
 
DM NOTE ON CURSE OF 
MADNESS
 
The DM may add a random trait to the insanity by 
rolling on the madness table from D&D 5th Edition.

Mummify 
Warlock Utility 22 
You prepare the corpse: Removing unnecessary organs; soaking
the body in preservatives and embalming oils; wrapping it up 
with linen wraps and amulets intended to ward away danger; 
before finally adding a resin finish to keep the body properly 
sealed from moisture. When all is said and done, the body has 
now become a mummy. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Creation, Warding
 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cost: 250 gp 
Cast Time: 1 hour. 
Effect: You prepare a corpse that is mostly whole and has 
been dead for less than a century to turn into a mummy. 
Until the spell is dispelled somehow, the mummy is 
indefinitely protected from decay, can't become undead 
by normal means, and cannot be raised from t he dead, as 
its organs are transported to a protective vessel of your 
choice and location. 
  
Once the vessel containing its organs is returned 
to the corpse, it can be raised from the dead, no matter 
how much time has passed. Other special rituals may 
return a corpse and not need the organs, though. 
  
When you complete this ritual power, you may 
make an Arcana check to set certain conditions that cause 
the mummy to return and defend its surroundings. You 
can also set certain conditions for creatures not to activate 
the mummy, such as by speaking aloud a certain 
password. When the conditions are met, the mummy will 
temporarily rise as an undead creature to defend its 
surroundings. It will not move further than 30 squares 
(150 feet) from its place of burial. When the conditions for 
its animation are no lon ger satisfied, the mummy will set 
the order of its surroundings back to rights as best it can, 
before re-entombing itself back in its resting place. 
  
The creature rises as a normal mummy, which 
requires 250 gp components and an Arcana check DC of 
15. They have Darkvision, a speed of +4, immunity to 
charm, disease, resistance 10 to necrotic and poison, but 
vulnerable 10 to fire, and any creature that re duces it to 0 
hit points is affected by your Warlock's Curse. 
  
Mummy: HP 100. AC 22, Fort 24, Ref 19, Will 23. 
Melee attack: +13 vs. Fortitude. On hit: 11 damage, grabs 
the target (escape DC 20), and if the target is already 
grabbed, deal an additional 10 necrotic damage. They are 
affected by mummy rot. 
Vestige Pact: The mummy has increased sentience, possibly 
even having some memories from their previous life. They 
can also travel indefinitely from their tomb, but they 
always have a desire to return, and can only do an 
extended rest there. 
Elemental Pact: The mummy has immunity to the damage 
of your current elemental affinity. In addition, it deals an 
extra 1d6 damage of that damage type with its melee 
attacks. 
Sorcerer-King Pact: You can instead make them rise as a 
mummy lord, but it requires 2,500 gp components 
instead, and an Arcana check DC of 30. They all have the 
same traits as above. 
  
Mummy Lord: HP 250. AC 30. Fort 28, Ref 24, 
Will 26. Melee attack: +20 vs. AC. On hit: 18 damage, and 
the target is immobilized until the end of their next turn. 
Standard Action Mummy's Curse: Close burst 10; +16 vs. 
Will; all enemies within the burst cont ract level 14 
mummy rot (Endurance improve DC 24, maintain DC 19, 
worsen DC 18).

its organs are transported to a protective vessel of your
choice and location.
Once the vessel containing its organs is returned
to the corpse, it can be raised from the dead, no matter
how much time has passed. Other special rituals may
return a corpse and not need the organs, though.
When you complete this ritual power, you may
make an Arcana check to set certain conditions that cause
the mummy to return and defend its surroundings. You
can also set certain conditions for creatures not to activate
the mummy, such as by speaking aloud a certain
password. When the conditions are met, the mummy will
temporarily rise as an undead creature to defend its
surroundings. It will not move further than 30 squares
(150 feet) from its place of burial. When the conditions for
its animation are no lon ger satisfied, the mummy will set
the order of its surroundings back to rights as best it can,
before re-entombing itself back in its resting place.
The creature rises as a normal mummy, which
requires 250 gp components and an Arcana check DC of
15. They have Darkvision, a speed of +4, immunity to
charm, disease, resistance 10 to necrotic and poison, but
vulnerable 10 to fire, and any creature that re duces it to 0
hit points is affected by your Warlock's Curse.
Mummy: HP 100. AC 22, Fort 24, Ref 19, Will 23.
Melee attack: +13 vs. Fortitude. On hit: 11 damage, grabs
the target (escape DC 20), and if the target is already
grabbed, deal an additional 10 necrotic damage. They are
affected by mummy rot.
Vestige Pact: The mummy has increased sentience, possibly
even having some memories from their previous life. They
can also travel indefinitely from their tomb, but they
always have a desire to return, and can only do an
extended rest there.
Elemental Pact: The mummy has immunity to the damage
of your current elemental affinity. In addition, it deals an
extra 1d6 damage of that damage type with its melee
attacks.
Sorcerer-King Pact: You can instead make them rise as a
mummy lord, but it requires 2,500 gp components
instead, and an Arcana check DC of 30. They all have the
same traits as above.
Mummy Lord: HP 250. AC 30. Fort 28, Ref 24,
Will 26. Melee attack: +20 vs. AC. On hit: 18 damage, and
the target is immobilized until the end of their next turn.
Standard Action Mummy's Curse: Close burst 10; +16 vs.
Will; all enemies within the burst cont ract level 14
mummy rot (Endurance improve DC 24, maintain DC 19,
worsen DC 18).

the shortcuts your notes never mention.

any allies assisting you take a -2 penalty to any skill check 
required by or affected by the ritual.

New Level 6 Utility Spells
 
 
Aid With Ritual 
Wizard Utility 6 
While you may not know the exact ritual, you know the base 
theory well enough, and can provide help making it more efficie
as long as you're told vague instructions about where to draw t
chalk or where to place the candles.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual 
Standard Action 
Ranged 5 
Requirement: An ally is performing a ritual. 
Effect: Choose one benefit: the ritual costs 25% fewer 
components, or it takes 25% less time to perform. This 
counts as you assisting with the ritual. You cannot assist 
the ritual in any other way. 
 
Forging Flame 
Wizard Utility 6 
You coax a flame past what its fuel could ever give it, and hold i
there. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Fire, Ritual, Creation 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You stoke a flame with your magic, hot enough to 
create items without a proper forge, for 24 hours. You or a 
smith still need the proper blacksmith tools and materials, 
or an approximation of them, but once obtained the work 
can be done anywhere. You can a lso use this flame to 
weld two metal items together, as long as you can hold 
them together for 1 minute. Breaking them apart 
afterward requires a Strength check against a Hard DC for 
your level when you used this power, +5. 
 
Invisible Object 
Wizard Utility 6 
You draw the light around it until there is nothing left to see.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Illusion, Deception 
Standard Action 
Melee touch or Ranged 5 
Target: One object weighing no more than 500 pounds 
Effect: The object becomes invisible until the end of your 
next turn. If you cast this as a melee touch effect, the 
invisibility instead lasts 10 minutes or until you dismiss it. 
If the object becomes part of an attack or a similar 
offensive action, the invisibili ty ends. 
Sustain Standard: If the target is within 5 squares of you, 
the invisibility persists until the end of your next turn. If 
this was originally cast as melee touch, the target needs to 
be within 20 squares instead, and it can be sustained for 
up to an additional 10 minutes. 
 
Lesser Rites of the General 
Arcane 
Wizard Utility 6 
The lesser rites cost you nothing but precision, and precision you
can spare. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual 
Free Action 
Personal 
Trigger: You are performing an Arcana ritual of 6th level or 
lower. 
Effect: You cast the ritual without expending any of the 
ritual's gold piece component cost. Any focus item the 
ritual requires must still meet its minimum cost. You take 
a -2 penalty to any skill check required by or affected by 
the ritual, and any allies assisti ng you take a -4 penalty. 
You cannot use this power to reduce the cost of the Brew 
Potion or Enchant Magic Item rituals. 
 
Protracted Jump 
Wizard Utility 6 
You or an ally are able to jump great distances for a longer 
amount of time through a slight manipulation of the spell.
 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Physical, Exploration 
Standard Action 
Melee touch 
Prerequisite: You have the Jump power (Wizard 2). 
Target: You or one creature 
Effect: The target can use a move action to jump up to 6 
squares or up to its speed, whichever is lower, without 
having to make an Athletics check. This lasts for up to 1 
minute, although it lasts only until the end of the next 
round if you or the target are in or enter a combat 
encounter.

Mirror Image 
Wizard Utility 10 
Three duplicate images of you appear, imitating your actions 
perfectly and confusing your enemies.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Combat, Arcane, Illusion, 
Deception 
Minor Action 
Personal 
Special: This does not affect enemies that can see through 
illusions or that have blindsight. 
Effect: Three duplicate images of yourself appear in your 
space. Whenever you are targeted by a melee or ranged 
attack, you gain a +2 power bonus to all your defenses for 
each duplicate image you have active, up to a +6 bonus. 
Each time a melee or ranged attack mi sses you, unless the 
attacker rolled an automatic miss, one of your duplicate 
images disappears, and the bonus granted by this power 
decreases by 2. When the bonus reaches 0, all your 
images are gone and the power ends. Otherwise, the 
effect lasts for 1 hour. During a short rest, if you have at 
least 1 but fewer than 3 duplicates, you gain 1 more 
duplicate image. 
  
Enemies may also target you with melee or 
ranged attacks that normally target more than one enemy, 
targeting you an extra time for each duplicate image you 
have.

Mass Animation 
Wizard Utility 10 
The room stands up all at once and waits to be told what it is fo
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Transmutation, Exploration 
Standard Action 
Close Burst 20 
Target: Up to 10 nonmagical objects within the burst that 
are not fastened down or held by a creature. Medium 
objects count as two, Large objects count as four, and 
Huge objects count as eight. You cannot animate Huge or 
larger objects. 
Effect: Each target animates until the end of your next turn, 
hovering above the ground with a fly speed of 5. You may 
immediately move all target objects up to their speed. 
While a target is animated by this power, you can move it 
5 squares through the air, and i t retains the ability to fly 
and hover. You may also use a minor action to have any 
number of target objects begin a mundane task related to 
their normal function: brooms begin sweeping, pots begin 
stirring, and so on. 
  
You cannot make attacks with the objects, even if 
it appears you can. A sword may flick and slice in the air, 
but with no aim or power behind it. 
Sustain Move: The animation persists until the end of your 
next turn for objects within 100 squares (about 500 feet), 
and you may move all target objects up to 5 squares.
