Beneficient 
Transformation 
Wizard Utility 16 
Tendrils of wispy energy surround your foe, assessing and 
stealing away some essential aspect of its being for your own us
 
Daily + Combat, Arcane, Transmutation 
Minor Action 
Ranged 10 
Target: You and one ally, or up to two allies 
Effect: Choose an enemy you can see. If you chose only one 
target, it gains up to three of the following benefits until 
the end of the encounter. If you chose two targets, each 
target gains up to two of the following benefits instead. 
Movement: If the enemy has a climb speed, a fly speed, or a 
swim speed, the target gains that movement mode and 
speed. 
Resist: If the enemy has resistance or immunity to a damage 
type, the target gains resist 10 to the same damage type. 
Senses: If the enemy has low -light vision, darkvision, 
blindsight, or tremorsense, the target gains that sense. 
Attacks: If the enemy has hit you or an ally with a non -
weapon, non-implement attack during this encounter, the 
target gains access to that attack and undergoes the 
physical changes needed to make it, such as growing claws 
or fangs. The target uses the enemy's attack bonus, 
damage, and other statistics for that attack. The change 
grants no other benefit; wings grown for a wing gust attack 
do not let the target fly, for example. The target cannot 
gain arcane, divine, or primal attacks, or attacks that rely 
on magical prowess, which covers most spellcasting 
enemies. If the attack is a recharge power, the target gains 
it as an encounter power instead. 
  
If the enemy has more than one option in one of 
these categories, you learn all the choices and choose one 
when you use this power.

New Level 22 Utility Spells
 
 
Dispel Disguise 
Wizard Utility 22 
The glamour breaks like a dropped mirror, and whatever was 
hiding behind the face stands bare in the light.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Transmutation, Illusion, 
Social 
Immediate 
Reaction 
Ranged 20 
Trigger: You succeed on an Insight check to recognize that a 
creature is not its true self because of a magical disguise, 
such as an illusion, shapeshifting, a charm, or a similar 
transmutation or mind -altering effect. 
Target: The disguised creature 
Effect: You dispel the illusion, shapeshifting, or similar effect 
on the target, so that everyone can see the target for who 
it truly is. 
 
Guardian Statues 
Wizard Utility 22 
The gargoyles on the roof were always there. They were only 
waiting to be asked. 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Creation, 
Stronghold 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 24 hours. 
Effect: You add one guardian to your stronghold in the form 
of a decorative, inanimate construct. Choose its type: 
metallic (such as a suit of armor), flying (such as a 
gargoyle), humanoid (such as a marble statue of a man, a 
wax figure, or a brass statue of a rider on a horse), or 
animal (such as a stone statue of a beast). You must 
perform this ritual once for each guardian you create. A 
stronghold can hold any combination of up to 4 guardians 
if it is small (such as an inn), up to 8 if it is medium (such 
as a castle), or up to 12 if it is large (such as a huge estate 
and its grounds, or a military camp). 
  
While your stronghold has at least one guardian 
and you are on its grounds, you can use the Animate 
Guardian Statues power. 
 
Animate Guardian Statues 
Wizard Utility 22 
The gargoyles on the roof were always there. They were only 
waiting to be asked. 
Encounter + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Stronghold, 
War 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Requirement: You are on the grounds of your stronghold, 
and it has at least one guardian created by the Guardian 
Statues power (Wizard 22). 
Cast Time: 5 minutes. 
Effect: You animate one or more of the guardian statues 
protecting your stronghold or bastion. The guardians act 
on their own under the DM's control, defending the area 
and slowing down attackers. They generally fight 
defensively and off-screen, pursuing no farther than the 
edge of your grounds or territory; if their fight ever 
matters, use the statistics below. All guardians are 
immune to disease, poison, sleep, psychic damage, charm 
effects, and other mind-affecting effects. A guardian can 
turn back into a statue , gaining resist 40 to all damage 
while it remains one. 
Metallic Guardian: +50 hit points, +5 Fortitude, and +2 to 
saving throws against ongoing damage. Resist 5 to all 
damage except slashing damage, such as from blades. -2 
speed and -2 Reflex. Melee attack: Intelligence vs. AC; 4d8 
+ Intelligence modifier damage, and the target is knocked 
prone. 
Flying Guardian: +2 Fortitude and +2 Reflex. Resist 5 to all 
damage except bludgeoning damage, such as from 
hammers. Fly speed 8. Melee attack: Intelligence vs. AC; 
2d8 + Intelligence modifier damage, and the guardian can 
move up to 4 squares after the attack. 
Humanoid Guardian: +10 hit points, +2 Fortitude, and +2 
Will. Melee attack: Intelligence vs. AC; 1d10 + Intelligence 
modifier damage. Ranged 10 attack: Intelligence vs. AC; 
1d8 + Intelligence modifier damage. When the guardian 
hits an enemy, it can mark that enemy, and a gua rdian 
adjacent to that enemy can attack it. As a minor action, 
the guardian can either slide an ally within 5 squares of it 
up to 2 squares or give another guardian 5 temporary hit 
points. 
Animal Guardian: +25 hit points, +2 Fortitude, and +2 
Reflex. Resist 5 to all damage except bludgeoning damage, 
such as from hammers. +1 speed and +4 AC against 
opportunity attacks. Melee attack: Intelligence vs. AC; 2d8 
+ Intelligence modifier damage. After hitting with i ts 
melee attack, it can shift 2 squares as a minor action. 
When it charges, it can move 1 extra square and deals 
1d10 extra damage. 
Warfare: If you are using the optional warfare rules, you are 
in a warfare encounter, and your stronghold has at least 
10 guardians, you can instead use this power to create a 
construct unit on the battlefield. The unit can move only 
within 1 square of your fortifi cation or stronghold, or 
within your back row if there is no fortification.

Permanency 
Wizard Utility 22 
You tie off the loose end of the spell so it can never unravel.
 
Daily + Non-Combat, Arcane, Ritual, Stronghold 
Standard Action 
Personal 
Cast Time: 10 minutes. 
Cost: 1 healing surge, plus the cost listed for the chosen 
effect (not paid if the check fails). 
Effect: You can make one of the rituals or powers in the 
tables below permanent, but you must know it. First, 
perform the ritual or use the power normally. Then 
perform this ritual, spend 1 healing surge, and make an 
Arcana check against DC 15 + the level of that 
ritual or 
power. On a success, you pay the listed cost and the effect 
becomes permanent. On a failure, the healing surge is still 
spent, but you do not pay the listed cost. The level of each 
ritual or power is shown in parentheses.
